Cantonese_Text: 返到嚟喇？瘦咗喎，食咗飯未呀？
English_Text: You’re back? You’ve lost weight — have you eaten?
I’ve got soup on, and dishes. Sit down first.
Not yet, po-po. What is there?

Cantonese_Text: 咁乖。飲多碗啦，煲咗成朝。
English_Text: Good boy. Have another bowl — it’s been on all morning.

Cantonese_Text: 得得得，我慢慢講。你學緊呀嘛。
English_Text: Fine, fine, I’ll go slow. You’re still learning after all.

Cantonese_Text: 我廣東話唔係好得，你講慢少少。
English_Text: My Cantonese isn’t great — a bit slower.
I’ll come and see you again soon.
Don’t know when I’ll be back.

Cantonese_Text: 阿仔，依家做緊乜嘢工呀？
English_Text: So — what work are you doing these days?

Cantonese_Text: 種嘢？好呀，實淨過打工。人工得唔得？
English_Text: Growing? Good — steadier than an office job. Pay all right?
Growing — I work at a facility.

Cantonese_Text: 夠使就得㗎喇。後生仔唔使急。
English_Text: Enough is enough. No rush when you’re young.
Enough to get by, not a lot.

Cantonese_Text: 退咗休喇，得閒飲下茶咁囉。
English_Text: Retired now. Just go for tea and that.
What about you, kau-fu — still working?

Cantonese_Text: 好呀。你揀日子，我幾時都得。
English_Text: Grand. You pick the day — I’m free whenever.
Let’s go for yum cha next time.

Cantonese_Text: 欸，你返嚟都冇同我講嘅？
English_Text: Oi — you came back and didn’t tell me?

Cantonese_Text: 算啦。今晚出唔出嚟食嘢？
English_Text: Fine. Coming out for food tonight?

Cantonese_Text: 啱啱返到咋，未嚟得切搵你。
English_Text: Only just landed — haven’t had a chance yet.

Cantonese_Text: 落樓下嗰間，好耐冇食喇。
English_Text: That place downstairs — haven’t been in ages.
I have to stay with po-po.
No need, I’ll get it. You’re the guest.
Ha — I’ll hold you to it.

Cantonese_Text: 今日婆婆問起你，你有冇打電話俾佢？
English_Text: Po-po asked after you today. Have you rung her?

Cantonese_Text: 打啦。佢淨係想聽下你把聲。
English_Text: Do. She only wants to hear your voice.
I don’t know what to say to her.

Cantonese_Text: 佢唔介意㗎。你講錯佢仲開心。
English_Text: She doesn’t mind. She likes it more when you get it wrong.

Cantonese_Text: 我廣東話講得唔好，同佢傾好辛苦。
English_Text: My Cantonese isn’t good — talking to her is hard work.

Cantonese_Text: 好呀。你叫聲婆婆，問佢食咗飯未，就夠。
English_Text: All right. Say po-po, ask if she’s eaten — that’s enough.
Teach me a few lines first, then.
Good lad. She’ll be made up.
Go in and sit — you’ll be sharing a table.

Cantonese_Text: 我哋有兩個人，想搵張枱坐。
English_Text: There are two of us and we would like a table.
Not sure — let me have a look.

Cantonese_Text: 餐蛋麵、凍檸少甜。凍飲加兩蚊。
English_Text: Spam and egg noodles, iced lemon less sweet. Two dollars extra for a cold drink.

Cantonese_Text: 一個餐蛋麵，凍檸茶少甜。
English_Text: Spam and egg noodles, iced lemon tea, less sugar.

Cantonese_Text: 我要一杯凍檸檬茶，唔該落少啲糖。
English_Text: I would like an iced lemon tea, with less sugar please.
Pay at the counter by the door.
Right. Order sheet’s here — fill it in yourself.
On the next table — help yourself.
Beef tripe. Nice bite to it — give it a go.
Does this have meat in it?
Oi Lo — what’s the plan tomorrow?

Cantonese_Text: 三號房呀？得四個阿姨得閒咋。
English_Text: Room 3? Only four of the aunties are free, mind.

Cantonese_Text: 林生，聽日摘三號房嘅葉呀，有冇人手？
English_Text: Uncle, de-leafing Room 3 tomorrow — got anyone free?

Cantonese_Text: 好。我而家同佢哋講。八點啱唔啱？
English_Text: Right. I’ll tell them now. Eight alright?

Cantonese_Text: 四個都夠喇，做半日就得。
English_Text: Four’s enough — half a day will do it.

Cantonese_Text: 四個唔夠，叫多啲人返嚟
English_Text: Four’s not enough, call more in

Cantonese_Text: 仲有，阿勝話四號房要插枝喎。幾時做？
English_Text: Also, Tsing says Room 4 needs clones cut. When?

Cantonese_Text: 冇問題。我記低咗，同埋話俾阿勝知。
English_Text: No problem. Noted — I’ll tell Tsing too.
De-leaf first — clones the day after.
Do both at once, saves time

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，哩批乾咗未呀？我想開始剪。
English_Text: Lo, is this lot dry yet? I want to start trimming.

Cantonese_Text: 好。噉今日我哋剪返琴日嗰批。
English_Text: Alright. We’ll do yesterday’s batch today then.

Cantonese_Text: 知喇。啲磅數要唔要即刻寫低？
English_Text: Got it. Do you want the weights written down as we go?

Cantonese_Text: 好呀。剪靚啲，慢少少冇所謂。
English_Text: Good. Trim it nice — slower is fine.
Be quick, it all has to clear today

Cantonese_Text: 冇問題。每袋都貼返標籤，寫埋日期同房號。
English_Text: No problem. Every bag gets a label with the date and room number.

Cantonese_Text: 要呀，磅完就寫，唔好靠估。
English_Text: Yes — write it as you weigh, no guessing.
No, tally it all at the end
Don’t mention it. Give me a shout if you need anything.

Cantonese_Text: 啱晒。你哋做嘢好細心，多謝你。
English_Text: Exactly right. You lot are careful — thank you.
No need for the room number

Cantonese_Text: 喂，林生話部抽濕機壞咗？
English_Text: Hello — Uncle says the dehumidifier’s broken?

Cantonese_Text: 開到但唔轉？可能係摩打。幾時買㗎？
English_Text: Powers on but won’t turn? Could be the motor. When was it bought?

Cantonese_Text: 係，四號房嗰部。開到但係唔轉。
English_Text: Yes, the one in Room 4. It powers on but doesn’t turn.
It’s broken — come and have a look.
I don’t know why — see for yourself.

Cantonese_Text: 一年？應該仲有保養。你搵返張單。
English_Text: A year? Should still be under warranty. Dig out the receipt.
Last year — about a year’s use on it.

Cantonese_Text: 好，我搵返張單。你幾時可以嚟？
English_Text: Right, I’ll find it. When can you come?

Cantonese_Text: 唔使保養喇，你整咗佢就得。
English_Text: Never mind the warranty — just fix it.
Let me look for it and get back to you.
Right — I’ll come at two, then.

Cantonese_Text: 得。不過三點前要嚟，我哋四點收工。
English_Text: That works — but before three, we knock off at four.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，乾房三號嗰批，你話幾時可以剪？
English_Text: Lo — the lot in Dry Room C. When can we trim it?

Cantonese_Text: 度咗。前面百分之十一，中間十四。
English_Text: Done. Eleven percent at the front, fourteen in the middle.
Has it been checked? Get the pen on it first.

Cantonese_Text: 明。噉中間嗰啲幾時再度？
English_Text: Right. When do I check the middle again?

Cantonese_Text: 噉前面可以落，中間留返。
English_Text: Then the front can come down, leave the middle.
Leave the whole lot two more days.

Cantonese_Text: 得。噉落咗嗰啲即刻剪定係等埋？
English_Text: Fine. And what comes down — trim it straight away, or wait?
Once tomorrow and once the day after.
Got it. I’ll get the aunties over now.

Cantonese_Text: 即刻剪。落咗放太耐會返潮。
English_Text: Straight away. Left down too long it draws moisture back.
Wait and do it with the middle.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，八號房嗰批剪晒喇。
English_Text: Lo — Room 8’s lot is all trimmed.

Cantonese_Text: 檢查咗六十磅。仲有二十幾磅未揀。
English_Text: Sixty pounds checked. Another twenty-odd still to sort.
Good. How many pounds have been checked over?

Cantonese_Text: 知。噉一磅袋要啱一磅係咪？
English_Text: Understood. And the pound bags have to be exactly a pound?

Cantonese_Text: 揀完先入袋。碎花另外擺。
English_Text: Sort it before bagging. Shake goes separately.

Cantonese_Text: 一齊入啦，都係同一間房。
English_Text: Bag it all together — it’s the same room anyway.

Cantonese_Text: 好。噉八號房總共出咗幾多磅？
English_Text: Right. So what has Room 8 given us altogether?

Cantonese_Text: 係，唔好多唔好少。封好貼返標籤。
English_Text: Yes — not over, not under. Seal them and label them.
You lot keep an eye on it.

Cantonese_Text: 一級四十二磅，二級二十八，三級十一。
English_Text: Grade one forty-two pounds, grade two twenty-eight, grade three eleven.

Cantonese_Text: 你話我知，我要記低。每級分開磅。
English_Text: Tell me — I need it written down. Each grade weighed separately.
You work it out and tell me later.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，叔叔琴日自己落咗乾房嘅花，冇同我講。
English_Text: Lo — Uncle took the dry room flower down yesterday himself and never told me.

Cantonese_Text: 花朵太乾喇，冇晒重量。老闆講咗三次唔好太乾。
English_Text: It’s far too dry — the weight’s gone. The boss said three times not to let it get dry.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔知佢噉做。等陣，我問下佢。
English_Text: I didn’t know he had. Hold on — let me ask him.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係第一次喇。冇人手做嘢佢就話夠乾。
English_Text: It isn’t the first time. When he’s short of hands, suddenly it’s dry enough.

Cantonese_Text: 係我冇同佢講清楚邊個話事。
English_Text: That’s on me — I never made it clear who decides.
I’ll speak to him next time.
He said it was dry enough.

Cantonese_Text: 由今日起，落唔落由你話事，唔係佢。
English_Text: From today, whether it comes down is your call, not his.
I’ll tell him to ask you in future.
Let’s have a meeting about it.

Cantonese_Text: 我明。我唔係嬲佢個人，我係嬲件事。
English_Text: I know. It isn’t him I’m angry at, it’s the situation.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好嬲佢，佢要排四間廠嘅人手。
English_Text: Don’t be angry at him — he’s rostering four sites.
The two of you sort it out.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，我有個建議，關於摘葉。
English_Text: Lo — I’ve got a suggestion, about the leaf removal.

Cantonese_Text: 第十四日第一次摘葉唔夠乾淨，剩返好多大葉，之後就容易發霉。
English_Text: The first pass on day 14 isn’t thorough enough. A lot of big leaf stays on, and then it moulds.
Go on — you’re the one who sees it every day.

Cantonese_Text: 係。同埋擋住光，底下啲花就細。
English_Text: Yes. And it blocks the light, so the lower flower stays small.
You’re saying it’s too dense — no airflow?
Right, I’ll tell them to do it more thoroughly.

Cantonese_Text: 好，我下次摘葉嗰陣剪一棵。
English_Text: Good. I’ll cut one next time they do the leaf.

Cantonese_Text: 噉你剪一棵樣板出嚟，我叫佢哋照做。
English_Text: Then trim one as a sample and I’ll have them work to it.
I’ll tell them to be more careful.
We’ll do it a few days earlier next time.
Of course. If I see it, I’ll say.

Cantonese_Text: 多謝。以後有咩睇到，照樣同我講。
English_Text: Thank you. Anything else you notice, tell me the same way.

Cantonese_Text: 我會同老闆講係你提出嘅。
English_Text: I’ll tell the boss it was your idea.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，你今朝先話我知，我點排人呀？
English_Text: Lo — you only told me this morning. How am I meant to roster anyone?

Cantonese_Text: 我要排四間廠嘅人，唔係得你哋一間。
English_Text: I’m rostering four sites, not just yours.

Cantonese_Text: 你講得啱，係我太遲。下次早兩日。
English_Text: You’re right — I left it too late. Two days ahead from now on.
I only found out myself just now.
Just help me out this once.

Cantonese_Text: 噉樣就最好。星期五六日我哋好忙，其他日得。
English_Text: That’d be best. Friday to Sunday we’re flat out — other days are fine.

Cantonese_Text: 我知。我做張表，一個月嘅日期一次過俾你。
English_Text: I know. I’ll do a sheet — a month of dates in one go.
Just say if you can’t cover it.
Right. Then I can actually get you people.

Cantonese_Text: 明白。我排星期一同星期四。
English_Text: Understood. I’ll put them on Mondays and Thursdays.
No problem. Anything comes up, I’ll call.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該晒。有咩排唔到，即刻打俾我。
English_Text: Thanks. Anything you can’t cover, ring me straight away.
I won’t be late telling you again.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：阿羅，我唔明。阿姨冇花剪，噉佢哋做乜？
English_Text: Uncle: Lo, I don’t follow. If the aunties have no flower to trim, what are they meant to do?

Cantonese_Text: 阿曉：唔係我唔畀佢哋做。係機器未做完，做咗就冇得補救。
English_Text: Ling: It isn’t that I won’t let them. The machine hasn’t had it yet, and once it’s hand-trimmed you can’t undo it.

Cantonese_Text: 你問得啱。等我講清楚兩件事先。
English_Text: That’s a fair question. Let me set out two things first.
The boss said they’re not to trim it.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：噉我啲人企喺度冇嘢做，都係浪費人工。
English_Text: Uncle: Then my people stand about with nothing to do. That’s wages wasted.

Cantonese_Text: 阿曉講嘅係次序，林生講嘅係人手。兩樣唔同。
English_Text: What Ling is describing is the order of the work. What you’re describing is manpower. They’re two different things.
The two of you work it out.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：噉你要早啲話我知有幾多花。
English_Text: Uncle: Then you have to tell me sooner how much flower there is.

Cantonese_Text: 啱。所以唔夠花剪就唔好叫咁多人嚟。
English_Text: Right — so when there isn’t enough flower, don’t send that many people.
If they’ve nothing on, they can go and de-leaf.

Cantonese_Text: 阿曉：冇問題，我夜晚發俾佢。
English_Text: Ling: No problem — I’ll send it to him in the evening.

Cantonese_Text: 就係。阿曉每晚同你講聽日有幾多。
English_Text: Exactly. Ling tells you each evening how much there’ll be tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，聽日有冇嘢做？冇嘅話我唔使返。
English_Text: Lo, is there work tomorrow? If not, I won’t come in.
Alright. So when are the aunties coming to trim?

Cantonese_Text: 聽日冇花。你可以跟阿姨嘅時間。
English_Text: No flower tomorrow. You can follow the aunties’ schedule.

Cantonese_Text: 好。有工作你隨時通知我，我就返。
English_Text: Fine. Tell me whenever there’s work and I’ll come in.

Cantonese_Text: 星期一。我會提早一日話你知。
English_Text: Monday. I’ll tell you the day before.
I’ll do anything — I don’t mind hard work.

Cantonese_Text: 你想唔想做多啲？種植室嗰邊要人。
English_Text: Do you want more hours? They need people in the grow rooms.

Cantonese_Text: 噉好。有需要我提早叫你。
English_Text: Good. I’ll call you in ahead of time when we need you.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：今日十八個人，剪咗一百五十四磅。
English_Text: Uncle: Eighteen people today, a hundred and fifty-four pounds trimmed.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：可能有一個係打雜，我冇計佢。
English_Text: Uncle: One of them was on odd jobs — I didn’t count her.

Cantonese_Text: 一百五十四？但係攞走嗰張寫一百六十八。
English_Text: A hundred and fifty-four? The pickup sheet says a hundred and sixty-eight.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：我寫咗喺張紙度，我搵返俾你。
English_Text: Uncle: I wrote it on a slip — I’ll find it for you.

Cantonese_Text: 打雜嗰個都要計，佢都收工錢。
English_Text: The one on odd jobs still counts — she’s still being paid.

Cantonese_Text: 林生：得。我叫佢哋自己簽。
English_Text: Uncle: Fine. I’ll get them to sign for themselves.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該。以後每個人一個號碼，寫低鐘數。
English_Text: Thanks. From now on — a number for each person, and the hours written down.

Cantonese_Text: 好。噉大家都清楚，唔使拗。
English_Text: Good. Then it’s clear for everyone and nobody has to argue.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，母株老咗喇，要換過批新嘅。
English_Text: Lo, the mothers are getting old — we need a fresh set.

Cantonese_Text: 我諗住留返兩棵好嘅，慢慢換。
English_Text: I was thinking keep two good ones and change them over gradually.
Tsing, when do you reckon we swap them?

Cantonese_Text: 好。仲有，四號房部抽濕機好似壞咗。
English_Text: Good. Also, the dehumidifier in Room 4 seems dead.
That’s a good way. You arrange it.
Don’t keep any, replace them all

Cantonese_Text: 有，我影咗相。今晚要唔要唔好入房？
English_Text: Yeah, took a photo. Should everyone stay out of the room tonight?

Cantonese_Text: 真㗎？你有冇記低幾多度？
English_Text: Really? Did you note what it was reading?
Got it. I’ll tell the uncles then.

Cantonese_Text: 係，熄咗燈就唔好入。我叫人嚟睇。
English_Text: Yes — lights off, nobody goes in. I’ll get someone to look at it.
Lo — does this whole row get cut?
Ah, got it. What about down the bottom?

Cantonese_Text: 淨係剪大塊嗰啲，細嘅唔好郁。
English_Text: Only the big fan leaves — leave the little ones.
Alright. Where do the cut leaves go?
Down the bottom — take it all off.

Cantonese_Text: 知喇。我剪得慢啲得唔得？我怕整爛啲花。
English_Text: Got it. Alright if I go slow? Worried about damaging the flowers.
In the bin — don’t chuck them on the floor.
Just drop them on the floor
Thanks, love. I’ll get going then.

Cantonese_Text: 慢慢嚟啦，唔使急。你剪得好靚㗎。
English_Text: Take your time, no rush. You trim beautifully.
Hurry up, it has to be done today

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，哩次插枝要幾多苗呀？東廠問緊。
English_Text: Lo — how many clones for this run? ESG are asking.

Cantonese_Text: 千一呀？我睇下母株夠唔夠枝先。
English_Text: Eleven hundred? Let me see if the mothers have the shoots.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠要九百，南廠兩百，一共千一。
English_Text: ESG want 900, NLT 200 — eleven hundred all in.

Cantonese_Text: 數完喇。得七百枝靚嘅，仲有一百枝細啲嘅。
English_Text: Counted. Seven hundred good ones, and another hundred that are small.

Cantonese_Text: 好，你數完話返我知仲剩幾多枝。
English_Text: Right — count them and tell me how many shoots are left.
There’ll be enough — no need to count.
If it’s short, just take more off the mothers.
Right. So how do we split ESG’s nine hundred?

Cantonese_Text: 噉先剪七百，剩返嗰啲聽日先。
English_Text: Cut the seven hundred then — the rest tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 細嗰啲都剪埋佢，夠數就得。
English_Text: Take the small ones too — just make the number.
Never mind, we’ll sort it later.

Cantonese_Text: 明喇。噉我而家開始剪，一點前搞掂東廠嗰批。
English_Text: Got it. I’ll start now — ESG’s lot done before one.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠先攞七百，南廠兩百，爭嗰兩百聽日補返。
English_Text: ESG take seven hundred, NLT two, and we make up the missing two hundred tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，今日剪邊啲先？啲膠箱堆晒喺度。
English_Text: Lo — what are we trimming first? The totes are stacked up.

Cantonese_Text: 好。糖果有五箱。藍種嗰啲點算？
English_Text: Right. Five totes of Candy. What about the Blue?

Cantonese_Text: 糖果嗰幾箱先，嗰個品種趕住出。
English_Text: The Candy totes first — that strain’s needed.

Cantonese_Text: 明。噉我叫啲阿姨淨係剪糖果。
English_Text: Understood. I’ll put the aunties on Candy only.

Cantonese_Text: 藍種唔好郁住，等糖果做完先。
English_Text: Leave the Blue for now — after the Candy’s done.
Do both — we’ve got the people.
Put the Blue to one side.

Cantonese_Text: 到而家六十磅。仲有五箱未磅。
English_Text: Sixty pounds so far. Five totes still to weigh.
Good. How many pounds of Candy are done?

Cantonese_Text: 冇問題。我今晚埋咗數話你知。
English_Text: No problem. I’ll tally it up and tell you tonight.

Cantonese_Text: 每箱磅完就寫低，夜晚埋咗數話我知。
English_Text: Write each tote down as it’s weighed, and give me the total tonight.
Weigh the lot in one go at the end.
It doesn’t need to be that exact.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，哩箱剪咗一半喇，好靚呀。
English_Text: Lo — half this tote’s done. Lovely stuff.

Cantonese_Text: 阿姨，你停一停先，等我睇下。
English_Text: Auntie — hold on a second, let me have a look.

Cantonese_Text: 係我冇講清楚，哩箱係藍種，唔係糖果。
English_Text: My fault — I didn’t say it clearly. This tote is Blue, not Candy.
Didn’t you look at the label?
Right — I’ll help separate it. It can be sorted.

Cantonese_Text: 唔使對唔住，真係唔關你事。我哋分返佢出嚟。
English_Text: No need to apologise — it really isn’t on you. Let’s separate it back out.
Just be more careful next time.
It’s fine, go take a break.

Cantonese_Text: 噉最好。噉樣一眼就睇到。
English_Text: That’s best. Then you can see it at a glance.

Cantonese_Text: 我以後每箱寫大隻啲個品種喺面。
English_Text: From now on I’ll write the strain bigger on every tote.
I’ll have Ling keep a closer eye.
Just remember to ask me first.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，六號房琴晚冇熄燈。
English_Text: Lo — the lights in Room 6 didn’t go off last night.

Cantonese_Text: 今朝六點阿勝入去先見到。而家熄咗喇。
English_Text: Tsing found it going in at six. It’s off now.
When was it spotted? How is it now?

Cantonese_Text: 唔關你事。不過真係要有人睇實。
English_Text: It isn’t on you. But someone does need to be watching it.

Cantonese_Text: 好。噉係我冇排人夜晚行一轉。
English_Text: Right. That’s on me — I never rostered a night walk-round.
Tsing should have gone in earlier.
Leave it — one night won’t matter.

Cantonese_Text: 由今晚開始，收工前有人行一轉，簽個名。
English_Text: From tonight — someone walks it before knocking off, and signs.
I’ll check it myself every night.

Cantonese_Text: 應該嘅。有嘢我實話你知。
English_Text: Of course. Anything comes up, I’ll tell you.

Cantonese_Text: 多謝你話我知，唔好等到出事先講。
English_Text: Thanks for telling me — don’t wait until something goes wrong.
Alright — let’s not have it happen again.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，我睇過張糧單，好似少咗幾個鐘喎。
English_Text: Lo — I’ve looked at my payslip. Looks like a few hours are missing.

Cantonese_Text: 上個禮拜三我做到七點，唔係五點。
English_Text: Last Wednesday I worked till seven, not five.

Cantonese_Text: 係咩？等我而家對返本簿。
English_Text: Is that right? Let me check the book now.
Are you sure you’re remembering right?
It’s alright. I know you’re busy.

Cantonese_Text: 我見到喇，係我寫漏咗。真係唔好意思。
English_Text: I see it — I wrote it down short. I’m sorry.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係忙唔忙嘅問題，係我漏咗。我而家補返俾你。
English_Text: It isn’t about being busy — I missed it. I’ll make it up to you now.
Yes — it’s been really busy lately.
I’ll put it in with next week’s.
Good. Then we both know where we are.

Cantonese_Text: 以後每日收工前我同你對一次鐘數。
English_Text: From now on we’ll check your hours together before you knock off.
I’ll be more careful from now on.

Cantonese_Text: 阿羅，林生叫我今日嚟。我未做過哩行。
English_Text: Lo — Uncle told me to come today. I’ve never done this kind of work.

Cantonese_Text: 唔緊要，我而家教你。你睇住我做一次。
English_Text: That’s fine — I’ll show you now. Watch me do one.

Cantonese_Text: 好簡單嘅，你睇下佢哋點做啦。
English_Text: It’s easy — just watch how the others do it.
What sort of work have you done before?

Cantonese_Text: 剪哩度，留返啲花。你試下。
English_Text: Cut here, leave the flower. Have a go.
Watch a few more times first.
Got it. And what about these?

Cantonese_Text: 啱，就係噉。慢慢嚟，靚過快。
English_Text: Yes — just like that. Take your time, neat beats fast.
Not quite — take a bit more off.
Right. I’ll call you if I’m stuck.

Cantonese_Text: 唔識就問我。問一次好過剪錯成箱。
English_Text: Ask me if you’re not sure. One question beats a whole tote done wrong.
Just follow one of the aunties.
My stomach hurts — for two days now.
I think I ate something bad.

Cantonese_Text: 我開兩日藥俾你。唔好得返就要照下。
English_Text: I’ll give you two days of medicine. If it doesn’t settle we’ll scan it.
I don’t know if I have a fever.

Cantonese_Text: 一日三次，飯後食。食晒佢。
English_Text: Three times a day, after meals. Finish the course.
Where did you lose it? When?

Cantonese_Text: 入面有咩？身份證？信用卡？
English_Text: What was in it? ID? Cards?

Cantonese_Text: 頭先喺地鐵度，大概半個鐘前。
English_Text: On the MTR just now — about half an hour ago.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係好記得，可能係街市，可能係地鐵，又可能……
English_Text: Not sure — maybe the market, maybe the MTR, or possibly…

Cantonese_Text: 即刻打去銀行停咗張卡先。我幫你落報告。
English_Text: Ring the bank and stop those cards now. I’ll take the report.

Cantonese_Text: 唔重要，我只係想要返個銀包。
English_Text: Doesn’t matter, I just want the wallet back.

Cantonese_Text: 攞住張報案紙，補領證件要用。
English_Text: Take the report slip — you’ll need it to replace your documents.
Come have a look, love — dead fresh.
Thirty a catty. How much do you want?

Cantonese_Text: 半斤咋喎。噉俾返你兩蚊啦。
English_Text: Only half a catty, mind. I’ll knock two dollars off.
Half a catty. Can you do better?
That’s dear — it’s much cheaper elsewhere.
Don’t you worry — good ones, of course.
Don’t give me the bad ones.
Have a look round — anything I can help with?
Sure — give me a shout if you need anything.
Let me check… yes, one L left.
Have you got this in a bigger size?

Cantonese_Text: 試身室喺嗰邊，一件咋喎。
English_Text: Fitting room’s over there — one item only, mind.
No need to try — I’ll take it.

Cantonese_Text: 啱呀，我要哩件。收唔收八達通？
English_Text: It fits — I’ll take it. Do you take Octopus?
Get on then — seats at the back.

Cantonese_Text: 我想去旺角，請問可以嗎？
English_Text: I would like to go to Mong Kok, may I ask if that is possible?
Eight dollars. Pay when you get off.
I don’t have to pay, do I?
Got it. I’ll stop at the lights.
Could you stop a moment, please.

Cantonese_Text: 行前少少，見到個天橋轉右就係。
English_Text: Go a bit further, turn right at the footbridge and it’s there.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好意思，去地鐵站點行呀？
English_Text: Sorry — how do I get to the MTR?
Take me to the MTR station.

Cantonese_Text: 哦，好。行、前、少、少，然後轉右。
English_Text: Oh — right. Go. A bit. Further. Then turn right.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好意思，講慢啲得唔得？
English_Text: Sorry — could you say that slower?
Five minutes, that’s all. It’s close.
Don’t mention it — take your time.

Cantonese_Text: 其實幾好吖，我上個禮拜去睇過。
English_Text: Actually pretty good — I went and had a look last week.

Cantonese_Text: 肯定係。將啲嘢擺低就走去攞飲品啦。
English_Text: Definitely. Put your things down and go grab the drinks.

Cantonese_Text: 究竟做乜咁遲㗎？佢返學就嚟遲到喇。
English_Text: What on earth is taking so long? He’s about to be late for school.

Cantonese_Text: 佢阿媽嗰日買咗個新書包，佢周圍揾都揾唔到。
English_Text: His mum bought a new school bag the other day and he’s looked everywhere without finding it.

Cantonese_Text: 我啱啱先發覺喺車尾箱。好彩至記得。
English_Text: I only just realised it’s in the boot. Lucky I remembered at all.

Cantonese_Text: 快啲拎出嚟啦，唔好再嘈喇，個個都聽到你把聲。
English_Text: Get it out quick, and stop shouting — everyone can hear your voice.

Cantonese_Text: 你星期六得唔得閒？聽講阿詩生日想搞餐嘢。
English_Text: Are you free Saturday? I hear it’s Sze’s birthday and she wants to do a meal.

Cantonese_Text: 雖然有功課，不過做完就得閒。幾點呀？
English_Text: I’ve got homework, but I’m free once it’s done. What time?

Cantonese_Text: 我都唔清楚，我覆你啦。你返去問埋你細佬。
English_Text: I’m not sure either — I’ll get back to you. Ask your little brother when you get home.

Cantonese_Text: 佢好叻㗎，一查就查到邊間餐廳最平。
English_Text: He’s sharp — one search and he’ll find which restaurant is cheapest.

Cantonese_Text: 老闆，最近生意點呀？成條街好似靜咗。
English_Text: Boss, how’s business lately? The whole street seems to have gone quiet.

Cantonese_Text: 咪就係。租又貴，人又少，真係好麻煩。
English_Text: Tell me about it. Rent’s high, footfall’s low — it’s a real headache.

Cantonese_Text: 不過你哩度近地鐵，機會梗係多啲㗎。
English_Text: But you’re near the MTR here — you must get more chances than most.

Cantonese_Text: 當然。有人叫我加價一倍，我話佢黐線。
English_Text: Of course. Someone told me to double my prices — I said he was off his head.

Cantonese_Text: 開頭我原本想買本辭典，點知咁貴。
English_Text: At first I meant to buy a dictionary, but it turned out so expensive.

Cantonese_Text: 網上所有嘢都揾到㗎啦，只係要識揀。
English_Text: You can find everything online — you just need to know how to pick.

Cantonese_Text: 我對哩啲冇乜興趣，而且我部電話成日死機。
English_Text: I’m not that into this stuff, and my phone crashes all the time anyway.

Cantonese_Text: 噉去咖啡店坐下，用佢哋部機租啲時間囉。
English_Text: Then go sit in a coffee shop and rent some time on their machine.

Cantonese_Text: 今次真係搬定係又講下算數？
English_Text: Are you actually moving this time, or is it all talk again?

Cantonese_Text: 搬㗎。除咗張床，所有嘢都送晒俾人。
English_Text: I’m moving. Apart from the bed, I’ve given everything away.

Cantonese_Text: 有陣時我覺得你就算搬十次都係噉樣。
English_Text: Sometimes I think you’d still be the same after ten moves.

Cantonese_Text: 咩都有嘞。我俾個地址你，你自己去睇啦。
English_Text: They've got everything. I'll give you the address, go have a look yourself.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好停喺哩度笑我啦，上去幫我搬嗰樣嘢。
English_Text: Stop standing there laughing at me — come up and help me shift that thing.

Cantonese_Text: 仲有九日就放假，暑假你哋去邊呀？
English_Text: Nine days till the holidays — where are you lot going over the summer?

Cantonese_Text: 未夠人齊，得三個。差幾百蚊都仲未計掂。
English_Text: Not enough of us yet — only three. And we’re a few hundred short, still not worked out.

Cantonese_Text: 我幫你數清楚。你撳機攞錢先啦。
English_Text: I’ll count it properly for you. Go take money out at the machine first.

Cantonese_Text: 低過三千我就唔去喇。好彩你唔係話請個靚女嚟。
English_Text: Under three thousand and I’m not going. Lucky you’re not talking about inviting some girl along.

Cantonese_Text: 你部機係咪正版㗎？個價平得好交關喎。
English_Text: Is your machine the real thing? That price is suspiciously cheap.

Cantonese_Text: 多數係啦。我企咗成個鐘頭先買到，好唔容易。
English_Text: Probably. I stood for a whole hour before I got one — not easy at all.

Cantonese_Text: 我發現部機好熱喎，唔舒服就唔好用。
English_Text: I notice it gets really hot. If it doesn’t feel right, don’t use it.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好嗌住，等我問下我老公佢識唔識整。
English_Text: Don’t start shouting — let me ask my husband if he can fix it.

Cantonese_Text: 隔離屋琴晚兩點仲喺度嘈，我瞓唔到。
English_Text: Next door was still making noise at two last night — I couldn’t sleep.

Cantonese_Text: 我哋而家買定遲啲買呀？
English_Text: Should we buy it now or later?

Cantonese_Text: 你有冇打電話上去問下？佢可能想解釋下。
English_Text: Did you ring up and ask? They might want to explain.

Cantonese_Text: 一般我唔想搞。哩度環境好，唔想搞到咁差。
English_Text: Normally I don’t want the fuss. It’s a nice place here — I don’t want to sour it.

Cantonese_Text: 噉你出邊行下先啦。你唔講我幫你講，唔使多謝。
English_Text: Then go for a walk outside first. If you won’t say it, I will — no need to thank me.

Cantonese_Text: 你搞錯咗，我叫你拎封信，唔係嗰封。
English_Text: You’ve got it wrong — I asked you for the letter, not that one.

Cantonese_Text: 邊封呀？黃色定係白色？我點知呀。
English_Text: Which one? The yellow or the white? How am I supposed to know.

Cantonese_Text: 醫生嗰封。話時話，佢啱啱打過嚟話遲半個鐘。
English_Text: The doctor’s one. By the way, he just rang to say he’ll be half an hour late.

Cantonese_Text: 噉我哋唔使咁迫喇，將來記得寫低啲嘢。
English_Text: Then we’re not so rushed. In future, remember to write things down.

Cantonese_Text: 佢哋結婚喎，聽日搭飛機返美國。
English_Text: They’re getting married, apparently — flying back to the States tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 我越來越唔明佢哋。開頭話喺度搞，後來又話唔搞。
English_Text: I understand them less and less. First they said they’d do it here, then they said no.

Cantonese_Text: 佢寧願亂啲都唔想成班親戚嚟。
English_Text: She’d rather it be a bit chaotic than have the whole family turn up.

Cantonese_Text: 哩個好似平啲喎，嗰個貴好多。
English_Text: This one seems a bit cheaper — that one's way more expensive.

Cantonese_Text: 講真，佢哋嘅生活我永遠都唔會過得慣。
English_Text: Honestly, I could never get used to the way they live.

Cantonese_Text: 我家姐揾咗成個月工，仲未有消息。
English_Text: My sister’s been job hunting a whole month and still nothing.

Cantonese_Text: 佢不嬲都揀得好緊要。唔通份份都睇唔上眼咩？
English_Text: She’s always been fussy. Surely not every single one is beneath her?

Cantonese_Text: 冇錯。為咗份人工，佢嘥咗好多時間見工。
English_Text: Exactly. For the sake of the pay, she’s wasted loads of time on interviews.

Cantonese_Text: 叫佢問下我阿哥啦，佢間公司遲啲請人。
English_Text: Tell her to ask my brother — his firm is hiring soon.

Cantonese_Text: 聖誕嗰晚我哋去屯門間酒店食飯，你去唔去？
English_Text: We’re eating at that hotel in Tuen Mun on Christmas night — are you coming?

Cantonese_Text: 個價錢點呀？我怕貴到爛。
English_Text: What’s the price like? I’m afraid it’s ruinously expensive.

Cantonese_Text: 一千一位，包酒。哩個城市邊度唔係噉㗎。
English_Text: A thousand a head, drinks included. Where in this city isn’t like that?

Cantonese_Text: 噉我認咗佢啦。不過嗰間舖啲牌子好廢，唔好去。
English_Text: Fine, I’ll take it. But the brands in that shop are rubbish — don’t bother.

Cantonese_Text: 琴日食嘢嗰陣突然間隻牙好痛，點算好？
English_Text: Yesterday while eating, one of my teeth suddenly hurt a lot — what should I do?

Cantonese_Text: 咪住，我諗下先。因為我聽日先出糧。
English_Text: Hold on, let me think. Because I don't get paid till tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 正常啦，你成日食糖。暫時咪咬硬嘢囉。
English_Text: No wonder, you eat sweets all day. Just don’t bite anything hard for now.

Cantonese_Text: 睇牙好貴，我得幾個毫子㗎咋。
English_Text: The dentist is expensive and I’ve only got a few coins.

Cantonese_Text: 唔睇影響更加大，個八都要睇。快啲去啦。
English_Text: Not going has bigger consequences — go even if you’re down to your last dollar eighty. Hurry up.

Cantonese_Text: 你個缸啲水草死咗一半，咩原因呀？
English_Text: Half the plants in your tank have died — what’s the reason?

Cantonese_Text: 我上個月骨折，成個月冇換水，直頭壞晒。
English_Text: I broke a bone last month and didn’t change the water for a whole month — it’s just completely ruined.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔信淨係為咗換水。你係咪太深咗個缸？
English_Text: I don’t believe it’s only the water changes. Isn’t your tank too deep?

Cantonese_Text: 唔好傾住喇，你幫我攞啲貨返嚟先。
English_Text: Let’s not get into it now — go get the supplies for me first.

Cantonese_Text: 舊年畢咗業，本來話返大陸做嘢，點知冇去成。
English_Text: I graduated last year and was going to work up north, but it never happened.

Cantonese_Text: 我上年都係。我老豆唔肯，講嘢好惡。
English_Text: Same for me last year. My dad wouldn’t have it — he speaks harshly.

Cantonese_Text: 我最憎人一朝頭早就播新聞嗌醒我。
English_Text: What I hate most is someone blasting the news first thing in the morning and waking me up.

Cantonese_Text: 如果係噉，跟住買啦，唔急㗎。
English_Text: If that's how it is, buy it after. No rush.

Cantonese_Text: 各有各法啦。你返去唱句歌就冇事㗎喇。
English_Text: Everyone has their own way. Go home, sing a line of something, and you’ll be fine.

Cantonese_Text: 佢失咗業三個月喇，成日話經濟差。
English_Text: He’s been out of work three months and keeps saying the economy is bad.

Cantonese_Text: 佢當我哋幫佢係老奉，我夾夠喇。
English_Text: He takes our help for granted — I’ve chipped in enough.

Cantonese_Text: 小心啲講。佢同你阿哥有關係㗎。
English_Text: Careful what you say. He’s connected to your brother.

Cantonese_Text: 到時我搭巴士走，記得幫我買個電芯。
English_Text: I’ll take the bus off when the time comes — remember to get me a battery.

Cantonese_Text: 冬天仲開冷氣？你有冇搞錯呀。
English_Text: Air-con in winter? Are you serious?

Cantonese_Text: 我啱啱返到，成身汗。等咁上下我就熄。
English_Text: I just got back and I’m soaked. Give it a bit and I’ll turn it off.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰陣個掣甩咗，你梗係唔記得整。
English_Text: The switch came off a while back — of course you forgot to fix it.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好無端端鬧我啦。細路先會喊㗎咋。
English_Text: Don’t tell me off out of nowhere. Only kids cry about it.

Cantonese_Text: 今晚睇電影定係喺屋企？我費事出去。
English_Text: Film tonight or stay in? I can’t be bothered going out.
You looking for someone to split rent with?

Cantonese_Text: 去啦。夜晚搭火車好快，唔使幾耐。
English_Text: Let’s go. The train’s quick at night — it won’t take long.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰隻嚇死人㗎，我睇完會發夢。
English_Text: That one’s terrifying — I’ll have dreams after watching it.

Cantonese_Text: 你性格就係噉。快啲決定啦，唔好望住個面。
English_Text: That’s just how you are. Decide quickly and stop staring at your screen.

Cantonese_Text: 我想申請做補習，不過冇乜經驗。
English_Text: I want to apply to do tutoring, but I haven’t much experience.

Cantonese_Text: 簡單啫。你識講普通話，比好多人好㗎喇。
English_Text: It’s easy. You speak Mandarin — that already puts you ahead of a lot of people.

Cantonese_Text: 要準備邊啲嘢？我怕佢問啲類似嘅問題。
English_Text: What do I need to prepare? I’m worried they’ll ask that sort of question.

Cantonese_Text: 佢哋多數接電話問幾句咋。唔使咁緊張。
English_Text: Mostly they just ring and ask a couple of questions. No need to be so tense.

Cantonese_Text: 你日日喺度噏股票，唔好煩我啦。
English_Text: You go on about stocks every single day — leave me alone.

Cantonese_Text: 我捱咗幾年先開到間舖頭，你估容易咩？
English_Text: I grafted for years before I could open that shop — you think it’s easy?

Cantonese_Text: 知啦。不過你啲款冇乜特色，任何舖都有。
English_Text: I know. But your styles have no character — any shop has them.

Cantonese_Text: 係啊，自己住太貴喇，所以想揾多兩個人。
English_Text: Yeah, living alone got too pricey, so I want to find a couple more people.

Cantonese_Text: 噉你話點囉。讓你揀一款，我入貨。
English_Text: Then you say. I’ll let you pick one style and I’ll order it.

Cantonese_Text: 禮拜六屋企人上嚟，間屋核突到死。
English_Text: The family’s coming over Saturday and the flat is disgusting.

Cantonese_Text: 比起上年好好多喇。你都慣咗㗎啦。
English_Text: It’s much better than last year. You’re used to it by now anyway.

Cantonese_Text: 我執到咁滯喇，淨係中間嗰笪未掂。
English_Text: I’ve nearly finished tidying — only that patch in the middle isn’t done.

Cantonese_Text: 經過門口嗰陣扮下唔見到咪得囉。
English_Text: Just pretend not to see it when you walk past the door.

Cantonese_Text: 佢硬係遲到，我覺得佢特登㗎。
English_Text: She’s always late — I reckon she does it on purpose.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好噉講。琴日上堂佢唔見咗個袋。
English_Text: Don’t say that. She lost her bag in class yesterday.

Cantonese_Text: 噉又係。我哋沙田間戲院等佢啦。
English_Text: Fair enough. Let’s wait for her at the cinema in Sha Tin.

Cantonese_Text: 記得熄電話。佢個態度唔好，但套戲音樂好正。
English_Text: Remember to switch off your phone. Her attitude’s poor, but the film’s music is superb.

Cantonese_Text: 我老婆嘅諗法變咗，甚至乎話唔做市場嗰行。
English_Text: My wife’s thinking has changed — she’s even saying she’ll leave marketing.

Cantonese_Text: 我同埋我同學可能有興趣啫。
English_Text: Me and my classmate might be interested, that's all.

Cantonese_Text: 你接受到咩？佢努力咗咁多年㗎喎。
English_Text: Can you accept that? She’s worked at it for so many years.

Cantonese_Text: 佢身體唔掂，成日焗到嘔。我唔攔佢。
English_Text: Her health isn’t good — the stuffiness makes her sick. I won’t stand in her way.

Cantonese_Text: 咁乖仔啦你。所以先話你哋夾。
English_Text: Good lad. That’s exactly why people say you two work.

Cantonese_Text: 不如一次過做晒佢，唔好分幾日。
English_Text: Why not do it all in one go rather than splitting it over days?

Cantonese_Text: 到底邊個話要分開做㗎？
English_Text: Who actually said it had to be split up?

Cantonese_Text: 冇人話。我上面問過，佢哋冇出聲。
English_Text: Nobody. I asked upstairs and they said nothing.

Cantonese_Text: 噉即係得㗎啦。做完仲有時間執乾淨。
English_Text: Then it’s fine. We’ll even have time to tidy up after.

Cantonese_Text: 合格咗。就噉過咗，實在唔知點解。
English_Text: I passed. Just scraped through — honestly no idea how.

Cantonese_Text: 好笑喎。你溫咗幾十個鐘㗎嘛。
English_Text: That’s funny — you revised for dozens of hours.

Cantonese_Text: 你好！我係小美。你係唔係學生呀？
English_Text: Hi! I'm Siu Mei. Are you a student?

Cantonese_Text: 好多謝晒！譬如今晚傾下，得唔得？
English_Text: Thanks so much! Say we chat tonight — that work?

Cantonese_Text: 係囉。搞掂喇，可以去台灣玩喇。
English_Text: Right. It’s done — now I can go to Taiwan.

Cantonese_Text: 旺角好難泊車，慳返啲時間唔好揸車去。
English_Text: Mong Kok’s a nightmare to park in — save yourself the time and don’t drive.

Cantonese_Text: 噉我搭車啦。順便食個早餐。
English_Text: I’ll take transport then, and grab breakfast on the way.

Cantonese_Text: 記得閂咗個掣，同埋啲嘢收埋佢。
English_Text: Remember to switch it off and put your things away.

Cantonese_Text: 知喇。業主今日嚟睇，唔好搞到咁亂。
English_Text: I know. The landlord’s coming to look today — don’t leave it in a state.

Cantonese_Text: 琴日發生咩事？我當時唔喺度。
English_Text: What happened yesterday? I wasn’t there at the time.

Cantonese_Text: 測驗改咗日子，結果一半人唔知。
English_Text: The test got moved, and half of them didn’t know.
Didn’t they send the information out?

Cantonese_Text: 發咗，不過寫得好差，質素成問題。
English_Text: They did, but it was badly written — the quality was the problem.

Cantonese_Text: 我趕住去銀行，佢哋五點就閂。
English_Text: I’m rushing to the bank — they shut at five.
Why do you always eat at that place?

Cantonese_Text: 追咗幾耐喇？成個過程好慢喎。
English_Text: How long have you been chasing it? The whole process is so slow.

Cantonese_Text: 間唔中打去問下，最重要係唔好停。
English_Text: I ring now and then — the main thing is not to let it drop.

Cantonese_Text: 我阿爸都試過，追咗大半年。
English_Text: My dad went through the same — chased it the best part of a year.

Cantonese_Text: 七點出街食飯，九點半返到。
English_Text: Out at seven for dinner, back by half nine.

Cantonese_Text: 以後唔好咁夜啦，聽日仲要返工。
English_Text: Don’t make it so late in future — there’s work tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 知喇。套戲個劇情好吸引，睇完先走。
English_Text: I know. The film’s story really pulls you in — I’ll go once it’s done.

Cantonese_Text: 個主角係邊個？咁多人講。
English_Text: Who’s the lead? Everyone’s talking about it.

Cantonese_Text: 十二歲喇。老得滯，行唔郁。
English_Text: Twelve. Too old now — barely moves.

Cantonese_Text: 我從來未養過狗，唔知點照顧。
English_Text: I’ve never kept a dog — I wouldn’t know how.

Cantonese_Text: 因為最平囉，四十蚊有隻大碗。
English_Text: Because it's the cheapest — forty bucks gets you a big bowl.

Cantonese_Text: 唔難㗎。淨係要日日帶佢落地下行一陣。
English_Text: It’s not hard. You just walk him downstairs every day.

Cantonese_Text: 我哋今晚食飯抑或睇戲？
你次次都是但。於是乎次次都係我諗。
English_Text: You always say either. So it’s always me deciding.

Cantonese_Text: 哈，好明顯係我信你嘅眼光。慢慢諗啦。
English_Text: Ha — clearly I trust your taste. Take your time.

Cantonese_Text: 有冇消息呀？我緊張到瞓唔着。
English_Text: Any news? I’m so on edge I can’t sleep.

Cantonese_Text: 無謂咁緊張。等唔到就等唔到。
English_Text: No point winding yourself up. If it comes, it comes.
I know. I’m trying my best not to dwell on it.

Cantonese_Text: 落樓下沖杯嘢飲，好過坐喺度。
English_Text: Go downstairs and make a drink — better than sitting there.
Tomorrow’s meeting is about which shares to buy.

Cantonese_Text: 不過我上次去，佢已經賣晒喇。
English_Text: But last time I went they'd already sold out.

Cantonese_Text: 我都係噉諗。你聯絡吓阿陳先。
English_Text: Same thought. Get hold of Chan first.

Cantonese_Text: 佢返咗鄉下，下星期先返嚟。
English_Text: He’s gone back to his village — not back till next week.

Cantonese_Text: 冚唪唥搬晒落停車場喇。
English_Text: The whole lot’s down in the car park.

Cantonese_Text: 非常之快喎。似乎你搵咗人幫手。
English_Text: That was very fast. Looks like you got help.

Cantonese_Text: 畀咗些少錢阿明。一陣間佢返嚟收工。
English_Text: Paid Ah Ming a bit. He’s back in a moment to finish up.
Sorry to hold you up a moment.

Cantonese_Text: 前嗰排嗰份報告，大部份做完未？
English_Text: That report from a while back — is most of it done?

Cantonese_Text: 嗰陣時太夜嘞。應該六點或者七點去先啱。
English_Text: You went too late. You should go at six or seven — that's the right time.

Cantonese_Text: 差唔多。只不過壓力大咗啲，慢咗。
English_Text: Nearly. It’s just that the pressure went up, so it slowed.

Cantonese_Text: 對唔住，我遲咗，排隊排咗半個鐘。
English_Text: Sorry I’m late — I queued for half an hour.

Cantonese_Text: 搞掂晒。嗰間舖頭好專業，值得幫襯。
English_Text: All done. That shop knows its stuff — worth going back to.

Cantonese_Text: 好，下次我都去。你有咩意見話我知。
English_Text: Good, I’ll go too. Tell me if you think otherwise.

Cantonese_Text: 今日出太陽，晏晝曬吓張被啦。
English_Text: Sun’s out — put the duvet out this afternoon.
Right. It’s filthier than I want to admit.

Cantonese_Text: 順便煲個湯，星期六阿媽嚟。
English_Text: Make a soup while you’re at it — Mum’s coming Saturday.

Cantonese_Text: 明白。於是乎我今日冇得唞。
English_Text: Understood. So I get no rest today.
What time have you been getting to sleep lately?
Hey, do you know Ah Keung?
Two or three. Genuinely too late.

Cantonese_Text: 留意吓身體啦。舊時你十一點就瞓。
English_Text: Watch your health. You used to be asleep by eleven.

Cantonese_Text: 知喇。聽日仲要去睇牙醫，瞓早啲好。
English_Text: I know. I’ve got the dentist tomorrow, so an early night’s wise.

Cantonese_Text: 阿妹喺醫院做咗檢查，冇事。
English_Text: My sister had a check-up at the hospital — she’s fine.

Cantonese_Text: 好彩。個情況複雜唔複雜？
唔算。醫生透過電話同我講晒。
English_Text: Not really. The doctor went through it all by phone.
That’s good. Mum dotes on her, you know.

Cantonese_Text: 星期日去飲茶啦，成家人一齊。
English_Text: Let’s go for yum cha Sunday, the whole family.

Cantonese_Text: 好呀。間餐廳七點鐘開門。
English_Text: Sounds good. The place opens at seven.

Cantonese_Text: 早啲去，唔使等。阿爺不停催我哋。
English_Text: Go early and skip the wait. Grandad keeps nagging us.

Cantonese_Text: 識啊，成日喺嗰度見到佢。
English_Text: Yeah, I see him over there all the time.
He just doesn’t want to be told off for being late.

Cantonese_Text: 間舖頭而家好出名，傳媒都嚟影相。
English_Text: That shop’s famous now — even the press come to photograph it.
Have they got enough hands, then?

Cantonese_Text: 唔夠。老闆話請人請咗六點鐘都未搞掂。
English_Text: No. The boss says he’s been hiring since six and still isn’t sorted.
That’s what happens once you get known.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該，可唔可以幫我搬呢箱嘢？
English_Text: Excuse me — could you help me shift this box?

Cantonese_Text: 冇問題。千祈唔好一個人搬。
English_Text: No problem. Whatever you do, don’t lift it alone.

Cantonese_Text: 知。上次我扭親腰，幾嚴重。
English_Text: I know. I did my back in last time, quite badly.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該晒。分開兩次搬好過。
English_Text: Thanks a lot. Better to split it into two trips.
Carrying all that on your back — aren’t you knackered?

Cantonese_Text: 佢有冇講過鍾意邊間？我想去試下。
English_Text: Has he ever said which one he likes? I want to give it a go.

Cantonese_Text: 慣咗。細個幫屋企孭到大。
English_Text: Used to it. Carried things for the family since I was small.

Cantonese_Text: 咁有心機。我幾乎冇你噉嘅耐性。
English_Text: That’s dedication. I’ve almost none of your patience.

Cantonese_Text: 習慣啫。大鑊嘅時候先知有用。
English_Text: Just habit. You only find out it’s useful when things go wrong.

Cantonese_Text: 我好掛住阿爺，好耐冇探佢。
English_Text: I really miss Grandad — haven’t visited in ages.
Then go. If you’re not too tired today.
Alright. I’ll put his ointment on while I’m there.
Remember not to tug so hard.
Nearly didn’t make it — I ran myself ragged.

Cantonese_Text: 次次都係噉。橫掂套戲遲十分鐘先開。
English_Text: Every time. Anyway, the film starts ten minutes late.

Cantonese_Text: 噉就好。你男朋友嚟唔嚟？
佢話香港哩啲舖頭好似都差唔多咋。
English_Text: He says these Hong Kong shops are all much of a muchness, that's all.

Cantonese_Text: 唔嚟。佢喉嚨發炎，喺屋企休息。
English_Text: No. His throat’s inflamed, he’s resting at home.
How have you been since you changed trade?

Cantonese_Text: 終於穩定返啲。人工冇以前咁好。
English_Text: Finally a bit steadier. Pay isn’t what it was.

Cantonese_Text: 總言之，我絕對唔想返轉頭。
English_Text: All in all, I absolutely don’t want to go back.

Cantonese_Text: 佢話唔賠，除非我證明到係佢整壞。
English_Text: He won’t pay unless I can prove he broke it.
That’s a headache. Did anyone see?
Yes. Chung was standing right in front.

Cantonese_Text: 噉就得。我贊成你直接面對佢講。
English_Text: Then you’re fine. I say go straight to him about it.

Cantonese_Text: 我走嗰時候，邊個養隻貓呀？
English_Text: When I'm away, who's feeding the cat?

Cantonese_Text: 事實同我哋估嘅一模一樣。
English_Text: The facts are exactly what we guessed.

Cantonese_Text: 一來慳返時間，二來唔使再開會。
English_Text: For one it saves time, for another we skip another meeting.
We may as well send it up this morning.

Cantonese_Text: 佢幫咗我咁多次，我欠佢好大人情。
English_Text: He’s helped me so many times — I owe him a big favour.
Worth taking him out for a meal.

Cantonese_Text: 假期先得閒。今朝五點半就返工。
English_Text: Only on my days off. I started at half five this morning.

Cantonese_Text: 噉樣做，健康點頂得順呀。
English_Text: Working like that, how’s your health meant to hold up?
Splitting it that way isn’t fair.

Cantonese_Text: 我冇所謂，是但點分都得。
English_Text: Makes no odds to me — split it however.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係。你最勤力，應該分多啲。
English_Text: No. You worked hardest, you should get more.
Yes, I'm a student. And you?
Me, obviously. You don't need to worry.

Cantonese_Text: 包括你自己先啱啦。同樣做咗成日。
English_Text: Count yourself in and it’s fair. You worked all day the same.

Cantonese_Text: 亂咗少少，但未至於失控。
English_Text: A bit messy, but not out of control.
The report needs the model number written down.

Cantonese_Text: 唔緊要，我太太幫我打晒。
English_Text: No bother — my wife typed it all up for me.
She’s been cross with me for a whole week.

Cantonese_Text: 我喺尖沙咀掛住威，唔記得接佢。
English_Text: I was in TST showing off and forgot to pick her up.

Cantonese_Text: 噉就係你唔啱喇。買啲嘢賠罪啦。
English_Text: Then that’s on you. Buy her something by way of apology.

Cantonese_Text: 佢忽然間話唔做，嚇死我。
English_Text: He suddenly said he’s quitting — gave me a fright.

Cantonese_Text: 噉你點樣入到去攞啲嘢食？
English_Text: So how are you getting in to grab the food?
Alarming. Did he give a reason?

Cantonese_Text: 話想成為師傅，要出去學嘢。
English_Text: Said he wants to become a proper tradesman, so he’s off to learn.

Cantonese_Text: 噉好成熟喎。我推薦佢去阿林度。
English_Text: That’s mature of him. I’d point him at Lam’s place.

Cantonese_Text: 講教育，話依家啲數據好唔靚。
English_Text: Education — says the numbers look bad right now.
There was a similar one not long ago.

Cantonese_Text: 佢哋個方式唔同，效果梗係唔同啦。
English_Text: Their method’s different, so of course the result is.
Nothing beats a shower in hot weather.

Cantonese_Text: 係呀。今晚睇唔睇個比賽？
English_Text: True. Are you watching the contest tonight?

Cantonese_Text: 睇。個氣氛好好，啲歌手唱到爆。
English_Text: Yeah. The atmosphere’s great — the singers go all out.

Cantonese_Text: 你開咗門俾我就得囉，唔好搞到咁複雜。
English_Text: Just leave the door open for me, that's all. Don't overcomplicate it.

Cantonese_Text: 根據上次，尾場先至好睇。
English_Text: Going by last time, it only gets good in the final round.
The cow’s sick — find a vet, quick.

Cantonese_Text: 理論上要打針，但係佢唔睬你。
English_Text: In theory it needs a jab — except it ignores you.
Fair point. It flatly refuses to move.

Cantonese_Text: 猛咁拉都冇用，直情推唔郁。
English_Text: Pulling like mad gets you nowhere — it simply won’t budge.

Cantonese_Text: 科技公司話會保護私隱權。
English_Text: The tech company says it’ll protect privacy rights.

Cantonese_Text: 你信咩？佢哋個系統成日出事。
English_Text: You believe that? Their system goes wrong all the time.

Cantonese_Text: 突然又話冇問題，總之答案唔清楚。
English_Text: Then suddenly there’s no problem — anyway, the answer isn’t clear.

Cantonese_Text: 唔理佢喇，去食碗米線好過。
English_Text: Forget them — better off going for a bowl of rice noodles.

Cantonese_Text: 聽聞荃灣開咗間新舖，好好食。
English_Text: I hear a new place opened in Tsuen Wan — supposed to be great.

Cantonese_Text: 你哋考完之後去邊飲嘢呀？
English_Text: Where are you lot going for drinks after the exam?
Have you seen it with your own eyes?

Cantonese_Text: 未。不過我試過佢哋個蛋糕，唔誇張，好食到痴線。
English_Text: No. But I’ve had their cake — no exaggeration, it’s insanely good.
Right, I’ll give it serious thought then.
Me. It’s on me, no need to ask.

Cantonese_Text: 近排真係攰，諗住早啲退休算。
English_Text: I’ve been shattered lately — thinking I’ll just retire early.

Cantonese_Text: 你逢星期日都返嚟食飯㗎？
English_Text: Do you come back for dinner every Sunday?

Cantonese_Text: 噉今晚有冇位？打麻雀呀。
English_Text: So is there a seat tonight? We’re playing mahjong.
Ugh, it's not over yet. Don't jinx it.

Cantonese_Text: 隨時。閂咗部電視機就開枱。
English_Text: Any time. Switch the telly off and we’ll set up.

Cantonese_Text: 你新嗰份工個職位叫咩？
English_Text: What’s the job title at the new place?

Cantonese_Text: 主任。人工好過而家，出糧又準時。
English_Text: Supervisor. Pay’s better than here, and payday’s on time.

Cantonese_Text: 聽日。佢要我帶埋證書同註冊嗰張紙。
English_Text: Tomorrow. They want me to bring the certificate and the registration paper.

Cantonese_Text: 禮拜日去博物館參觀，之後打邊爐。
English_Text: Museum on Sunday, then hotpot after.

Cantonese_Text: 真係？我以為你淨係識打機同踢波。
English_Text: Really? I thought all you did was game and play football.

Cantonese_Text: 而家淡季，唔使返工，梗係揾啲嘢做。
English_Text: It’s the slow season, no work on — of course I find something to do.
How are you getting here — train or minibus?

Cantonese_Text: 嗱，我識嗰間好靚，不過貴啲。
English_Text: Look, I know a place that's really nice — bit pricey though.

Cantonese_Text: 你喺地鐵站門口等我，我兜個彎就到。
English_Text: Wait for me at the station entrance — I’ll swing round and be there.

Cantonese_Text: 幾點？夠鐘我哋就走㗎喇。
English_Text: What time? Once it’s time we’re off.

Cantonese_Text: 五點。噚日我前面架車死火，所以遲咗。
English_Text: Five. Yesterday the car in front of me broke down, that’s why I was late.

Cantonese_Text: 佢噚日當住班人鬧我，真係離譜。
English_Text: He had a go at me in front of everyone yesterday — completely out of order.

Cantonese_Text: 噉樣即係騷擾。要唔要佢同你道歉？
English_Text: That’s harassment. Do you want him to apologise to you?

Cantonese_Text: 唔使。同佢交惡冇好處，後果好大。
English_Text: No. Falling out with him gains me nothing, and it’d cost a lot.

Cantonese_Text: 都係。不過佢噉樣做人真係難頂。
English_Text: Fair enough. Still, he’s hard work as a person.
Don’t shove me — I’m carrying something.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好意思，我趕住躉啲貨落去。
English_Text: Sorry — I’m rushing to dump this lot downstairs.

Cantonese_Text: 慢慢啦，大把時間。㷫都冇用。
English_Text: Take your time, there’s loads of it. Getting wound up won’t help.

Cantonese_Text: 有啲同學喺嗰間公司做，佢話可以平啲。
English_Text: Some classmates work at that company — they said they can get it cheaper.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔㷫，我淨係想早啲收工。
English_Text: I’m not wound up, I just want to knock off early.
Does the old boy remember you?

Cantonese_Text: 認得。上次佢仲同我傾咗好耐計。
English_Text: He does. Last time he had a long chat with me.

Cantonese_Text: 難得。佢平時唔點招呼人㗎。
English_Text: That’s rare. He doesn’t usually make much of anyone.

Cantonese_Text: 佢話後生嗰陣做過同一行，所以先肯幫忙。
English_Text: He said he was in the same trade when he was young — that’s why he’ll help.
How much was the lens on that camera of yours?

Cantonese_Text: 唔平。買咗保險，跌爛都唔怕。
English_Text: Not cheap. I insured it, so I’m not worried if it drops.

Cantonese_Text: 啲人成日講燕梳，其實同保險係同一樣嘢。
English_Text: People say “yin-so” all the time — it’s the same thing as 保險.

Cantonese_Text: 係囉，一個係英文嚟嘅啫。
English_Text: Right — one of them’s just the English.
Your pronunciation’s come on a lot.
How much are you selling this one for?

Cantonese_Text: 我一直練緊。不過有啲字我到而家都講唔啱。
English_Text: I keep at it. Some words I still can’t get right, though.

Cantonese_Text: 邊個講法先啱，其實冇一定。
English_Text: Which way is correct — there isn’t really one answer.

Cantonese_Text: 噉我就放心。我打算下個月同人傾多啲。
English_Text: That’s a relief. I’m planning to talk to people more next month.

Cantonese_Text: 部儀器點操作？我未用過。
English_Text: How do you work this thing? I’ve never used one.

Cantonese_Text: 我教你。有困難就即刻叫我，唔好自己撞。
English_Text: I’ll show you. Any trouble, shout — don’t go blundering at it.

Cantonese_Text: 兩部機睇落差唔多，係咪一樣？
English_Text: The two machines look much the same — are they?

Cantonese_Text: 唔係。型號相差少少，處理嘅嘢就唔同。
English_Text: No. The models differ slightly, and they handle different things.

Cantonese_Text: 冇事。去咗跌打嗰度，佢整咗兩下就鬆返。
English_Text: It’s fine. Went to the bone-setter, he worked on it twice and it loosened up.
Do you need anything for it?

Cantonese_Text: 一百蚊。人哋賣一百五㗎唧。
English_Text: A hundred. Other people sell it for one-fifty, you know.

Cantonese_Text: 食成藥就得，唔使做手術。
English_Text: Over-the-counter stuff will do — no surgery needed.

Cantonese_Text: 有。廿年喇，大家依然係朋友。
English_Text: We do. Twenty years and we’re still mates.

Cantonese_Text: 難得。咁多年，彼此都冇變。
English_Text: That’s rare. All those years and neither of you has changed.

Cantonese_Text: 忽然講起，我先發覺過咗成個年代。
English_Text: Now you mention it, I hadn’t noticed a whole era going by.
Do you listen to the radio?

Cantonese_Text: 開車嗰陣聽。啲報導講亞洲嘅製造業。
English_Text: When I’m driving. The reports are about manufacturing in Asia.

Cantonese_Text: 你聽得明？佢哋講國語定廣東話？
English_Text: You follow it? Do they speak Mandarin or Cantonese?

Cantonese_Text: 廣東話。不過啲字好書面，聽眾要慣先得。
English_Text: Cantonese. But the wording is bookish — listeners have to get used to it.
Do me a favour — eighty, is that alright?

Cantonese_Text: 我都係囖。噉我哋有啲嘢一樣喇。
English_Text: I am too. So we have a few things in common, then.

Cantonese_Text: 算啦算啦，快啲攞去，我要收檔返屋企喇。
English_Text: Fine, fine, take it and go. I'm packing up and heading home.

Cantonese_Text: 哎吔，我打咗三次電話你都冇聽。
English_Text: Oh no — I rang you three times and you didn't pick up.

Cantonese_Text: 原來係你？我以為係公司搵我。
English_Text: Oh, it was you? I thought it was work calling.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好意思，唔夠時間解釋。有個問題想問你。
English_Text: Sorry, no time to explain. I've got a question for you.

Cantonese_Text: 講啦，聽到你把聲我都開心。
English_Text: Go on. Just hearing your voice makes me happy.
This fish used to be a lot cheaper.

Cantonese_Text: 係啊，而家太貴，我淨係買少少。
English_Text: Yeah, too expensive now — I only buy a little bit.

Cantonese_Text: 大家都話難做，不過又唔見佢哋收檔。
English_Text: Everyone says business is hard, but you don't see them shutting up shop either.

Cantonese_Text: 不如試下裏邊嗰間，聽講平啲。
English_Text: How about we try the one inside — they say it's cheaper.

Cantonese_Text: 我今日去剪頭髮，等咗成粒鐘。
English_Text: I went for a haircut today and waited a whole hour.

Cantonese_Text: 喂，你去咗邊呀？我等咗你幾耐嚹。
English_Text: Hey, where'd you go? I've been waiting ages for you.

Cantonese_Text: 通常唔使咁耐㗎喎，今日點解？
English_Text: It doesn't usually take that long. What happened today?

Cantonese_Text: 唔知道，可能其他客多咗。整完之後又唔同咗個樣。
English_Text: No idea — maybe more customers. And after it was done I looked different anyway.

Cantonese_Text: 辛苦晒。亦都唔差吖，我覺得幾靚。
English_Text: You poor thing. It's not bad though — I reckon it looks good.
Damn, I forgot to bring the book again.

Cantonese_Text: 第一次咩？你差唔多次次都係噉。
English_Text: First time, is it? You do this pretty much every time.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好笑我啦。你架車喺邊度？我哋一齊返去攞。
English_Text: Don't laugh at me. Where's your car? Let's go back and get it together.

Cantonese_Text: 落面等啦。你着返件外套先，出面凍。
English_Text: Wait downstairs. Put your jacket on first — it’s cold out.

Cantonese_Text: 我哋幾時去旅行？揀邊個地方好？
English_Text: When are we travelling? Which place should we pick?

Cantonese_Text: 一係去日本，一係喺附近行下。
English_Text: Either Japan, or just wander somewhere nearby.

Cantonese_Text: 日本梗係犀利啲啦，不過貴到死。
English_Text: Japan's obviously the better one, but it's dead expensive.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係啩，我話咗今日唔得㗎喎。
English_Text: No way — I did say I couldn't make it today.

Cantonese_Text: 噉唔使諗喇，之前儲落嗰啲錢應該掂嘅。
English_Text: Nothing to think about then — the money we saved before should cover it.

Cantonese_Text: 頭先嗰個係翻版嚟㗎，你睇下啲英文字。
English_Text: That one just now is a knock-off — look at the English on it.
Oh no, I thought it was real.

Cantonese_Text: 根本冇可能咁平。特別係哩件。
English_Text: There's no way it'd be that cheap. Especially this one.

Cantonese_Text: 即刻攞返去換啦，我而家先明。
English_Text: I'll take it straight back and swap it. Only now do I get it.

Cantonese_Text: 我每個禮拜五都要做到半夜。
English_Text: Every Friday I have to work till midnight.
That rough? Do you at least earn more for it?

Cantonese_Text: 啱啱夠交租咋。然之後又繼續。
English_Text: Only just enough for rent. And then it starts again.

Cantonese_Text: 坐低唞下啦，一樣咁攰嘅，唔差你一個鐘。
English_Text: Sit down and rest. You're knackered either way — one hour won't make the difference.

Cantonese_Text: 今日出去睇嗰套戲好唔好睇？
English_Text: Was that film you went out to see any good?

Cantonese_Text: 但係嗰啲人又話你會嚟。
English_Text: But that lot said you were coming.

Cantonese_Text: 頭半個鐘好悶，後面先至好睇。
English_Text: The first half hour was dull — it only got good later on.

Cantonese_Text: 噉即係唔緊要囉，我全部都未睇過。
English_Text: So it doesn't much matter — I haven't seen any of them.

Cantonese_Text: 返工之前傾多陣啦，我個感覺係你會鍾意。
English_Text: Let's chat a bit more before work. My feeling is you'd like it.

Cantonese_Text: 哩度好凍呀，可唔可以換個位？
English_Text: It’s freezing here — can we swap seats?

Cantonese_Text: 跟我坐嗰邊啦，個個都話嗰邊暖啲。
English_Text: Come sit over there with me — everyone says that side’s warmer.

Cantonese_Text: 實係啦。我朋友早咗嚟，佢都係噉講。
English_Text: Must be. My mate got here early and said the same.

Cantonese_Text: 噉唔需要理由喇，快啲換啦，坐喺度好悶。
English_Text: No need for a reason then — hurry up and move, sitting here is dull.

Cantonese_Text: 我細個好肥㗎，你記唔記得？
English_Text: I was really chubby as a kid — do you remember?

Cantonese_Text: 記得嘍。嗰陣考試前你重要食多兩碗飯。
English_Text: I do. Back then you’d eat two extra bowls before an exam.

Cantonese_Text: 而家情況更加差，人工少咗，重要慳。
English_Text: It’s worse now — pay’s down and I still have to save.

Cantonese_Text: 噉樣就冇計喇。下次一齊去啦。
English_Text: Nothing to be done then. Let's go together next time.

Cantonese_Text: 望住今年好啲啦。行，食飯先。
English_Text: Here’s hoping this year’s better. Come on, food first.

Cantonese_Text: 我介紹下，哩位係我大佬，佢姓陳。
English_Text: Let me introduce you — this is my big brother, surname Chan.

Cantonese_Text: 你好，點稱呼呀？我基本上都記唔到名。
English_Text: Hi, what should I call you? I basically never remember names.

Cantonese_Text: 叫佢阿陳得㗎喇。佢搭車嚟，坐咗四十分鐘。
English_Text: Just call him Ah Chan. He took the bus, forty minutes of it.

Cantonese_Text: 一路企住呀？辛苦晒。入嚟坐低啦。
English_Text: Standing the whole way? Poor you. Come in and sit down.

Cantonese_Text: 哩個真係抵，起碼平咗一半。
English_Text: This is a proper bargain — at least half off.

Cantonese_Text: 勁喎。不過未必個個都覺得抵嘅。
English_Text: Impressive. Though not everyone would think it’s worth it.

Cantonese_Text: 總之我完全滿意，希望佢哋唔好加價。
English_Text: Anyway I’m completely happy — hope they don’t put the price up.

Cantonese_Text: 搞笑，你講嘢嘅意思即係想我都買囉。
English_Text: Funny — what you mean is you want me to buy one too.

Cantonese_Text: 最近好無聊，日日飲奶茶等放工。
English_Text: Lately it’s so dull — milk tea every day waiting for knock-off.

Cantonese_Text: 你覺得嗰間舖頭做得點呀？
English_Text: What do you reckon about how that shop is doing?

Cantonese_Text: 上次同事叫你去跳舞，好玩㗎喎。
English_Text: Last time a colleague asked you dancing — that was fun.

Cantonese_Text: 我最後冇去。連水都唔想飲，好攰。
English_Text: I didn’t end up going. Too tired to even drink water.

Cantonese_Text: 借我啲力啦。行啦，我請你飲杯凍嘅。
English_Text: Lend me some energy. Come on, I’ll buy you a cold one.

Cantonese_Text: 講真，哩份工作我做唔落去。
English_Text: Honestly, I can’t keep doing this job.

Cantonese_Text: 同老細講咗未？佢會明嘅啩。
English_Text: Have you told the boss? He’d probably understand.

Cantonese_Text: 平時佢淨係識鬧人。我諗唔到辦法。
English_Text: Normally he only knows how to tell people off. I can’t think of a way.

Cantonese_Text: 聽日早啲起身，去到公司先傾。做嘢之前佢好講嘢啲。
English_Text: Get up early tomorrow and talk when you get in. He’s easier to talk to before work starts.

Cantonese_Text: 十二號嗰晚我哋入去食飯，你訂咗枱未呀？
English_Text: We’re going in for dinner on the 12th — have you booked a table yet?

Cantonese_Text: 訂咗喇。不過間舖本身唔算大，我哋坐入邊張枱。
English_Text: Booked. But the place isn’t big to begin with, so let’s take the table inside.

Cantonese_Text: 入邊好啲咯。出面部電視係噉播，好嘈。
English_Text: Inside is better, yeah. The telly out front plays non-stop — it’s loud.
to go down / to carry on
to fix (整唔整得返 = can it be fixed)
to rise / to build / to start
to bring down (off the drying line)
to be called / so to speak
to study / to be at school
to be short by (仲爭兩百 = two hundred short)
(question particle — far less common than 咩 in speech)
-odd, a bit over (十零日 = ten-odd days)

Cantonese_Text: 我本身諗住教書，反而入咗行做嘢。
English_Text: I originally meant to teach, but I ended up working in the trade instead.

Cantonese_Text: 份嘢幾時交？我仲考慮緊。
English_Text: When is that thing due? I’m still thinking it over.

Cantonese_Text: 哩隻貓好得意呀，係噉望住我。
English_Text: This cat is so cute — it keeps staring at me.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔信神，不過肯定有啲嘢解唔到。
English_Text: I don’t believe in god, but there are definitely things you can’t explain.
itself / originally / in the first place
to hand in / to hand over
to go over / to head off to
(marker — take X and do Y to it)
to book / to reserve / to order

Cantonese_Text: 對於哩個要求，我覺得唔太合理。
English_Text: As for this demand, I don’t think it’s very reasonable.

Cantonese_Text: 先生教嘅方法同我以前學嘅唔同。
English_Text: The teacher’s method is different from how I learned before.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰日有隻雀飛咗入屋，大家笑到肚痛。
English_Text: A bird flew into the house the other day and everyone laughed till their sides hurt.

Cantonese_Text: 哩個社會周圍都係舊嘢，好難改。
English_Text: This society is full of old habits everywhere — hard to change.

Cantonese_Text: 兩個真係冇乜分別，你唔好咁傻。
English_Text: There’s really no difference between the two — don’t be daft.

Cantonese_Text: 郭生喺嗰段路影咗幾張相。
English_Text: Mr Kwok took a few photos along that stretch of road.

Cantonese_Text: 我跌咗粒鈕，你幫我拍張相睇下。
English_Text: I dropped a button — take a photo of it for me to look at.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔清楚，返去查清楚先覆你。
English_Text: I’m not sure — I’ll check when I get back and then reply to you.
(classifier for stretches — of road, time, text)
to reply / get back to someone

Cantonese_Text: 越近街口越貴，隔離條街平好多。
English_Text: The closer to the corner the pricier — the next street over is much cheaper.

Cantonese_Text: 我行到隻腳都痛，然後坐低飲咗杯嘢。
English_Text: I walked till my feet hurt, then sat down and had a drink.

Cantonese_Text: 哩排興買電子嘢，好多人報咗去外國入貨。
English_Text: Electronics are in right now — a lot of people signed up to go abroad and buy stock.

Cantonese_Text: 本聖經擺咗喺個櫃底好耐。
English_Text: The Bible has been sitting at the bottom of the cupboard for ages.
mad / off your head — friendly between mates

Cantonese_Text: 開頭好熱，我除咗件衫先舒服啲。
English_Text: It was hot at first — I only felt better after taking off a layer.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰晚佢唱咗首中國歌，全場都靜晒。
English_Text: That night he sang a Chinese song and the whole room went silent.

Cantonese_Text: 走之前記得關燈，唔係業主會鬧。
English_Text: Remember to switch off the lights before you go, or the landlord will have a go at you.

Cantonese_Text: 我一坐親哩張凳就腰痛。
English_Text: Every time I sit in this chair my back hurts.
to line up / row / (哩排 = lately)
(suffix — whenever / to get hurt doing something)
to look / to watch / to read

Cantonese_Text: 佢喺廠度做咗好耐，能力冇人信得過。
English_Text: He’s worked at the factory for years — nobody doubts his ability.

Cantonese_Text: 我留咗個位俾你，唔好話我唔敢諗你。
English_Text: I saved a seat for you — don’t say I didn’t think of you.

Cantonese_Text: 哩個國家啲嘢好似我哋嗰樣，價錢削咗一半。
English_Text: Things in this country are like ours, but the prices are cut in half.

Cantonese_Text: 佢錄咗我把聲，係唔係好衰？
English_Text: He recorded my voice — isn’t that awful of him?
to keep / to stay / to leave behind
to give (a gift) / to see off

Cantonese_Text: 黃生話政府始終會出手，我覺得好奇怪。
English_Text: Mr Wong says the government will step in eventually — I find that odd.
Does the meal include a drink?

Cantonese_Text: 其中一塊爛咗，換一塊得唔得？
English_Text: One of them is broken — can I swap it for another?

Cantonese_Text: 放假前要交晒啲數，唔好留低。
English_Text: All the accounts have to be handed in before the holiday — don’t leave any.
to be on holiday / a day off
to count (數清楚 = count it properly)

Cantonese_Text: 我喺澳洲住咗兩年，講英文容易咗好多。
English_Text: I lived in Australia two years and speaking English got a lot easier.

Cantonese_Text: 佢肯溫書就得，冇乜特別方法。
English_Text: If he’s willing to revise, that’s enough — there’s no special trick.

Cantonese_Text: 條線俾隻狗咬爛咗，普通舖頭都有得換。
English_Text: The dog chewed the cable through — any ordinary shop can replace it.

Cantonese_Text: 我企喺地下等咗好耐，個價都唔平。
English_Text: I stood downstairs waiting ages, and the price still wasn’t cheap.
to stand (冇位企 = nowhere to stand)

Cantonese_Text: 哩間大學嘅服務一般，不過位置好方便。
English_Text: The service at this university is nothing special, but the location is very convenient.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰個靚仔行過去講咗兩句就走。
English_Text: That lad walked over, said a couple of words and left.

Cantonese_Text: 佢喺隊後面出現，個個都以為佢好有錢。
English_Text: He turned up at the back of the queue and everyone assumed he was loaded.

Cantonese_Text: 多謝你俾嘅嘢，我收到喇。
English_Text: Thank you for what you gave me — I’ve received it.

Cantonese_Text: 佢主要教中文，例如寫字同讀音。
English_Text: She mainly teaches Chinese — writing and pronunciation, for example.

Cantonese_Text: 嗰個男仔以前喺法國住過，只係唔記得晒。
English_Text: That boy lived in France before — he just doesn’t remember any of it.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該你上嚟幫我拎啲嘢好嗎？
English_Text: Could you come up and help me carry some things?

Cantonese_Text: 車廂好迫，我以為擠唔入去。
English_Text: The carriage was packed — I thought I wouldn’t squeeze in.
how would I know / and then it turned out
by the way / speaking of which
to get it wrong / mix it up

Cantonese_Text: 佢考得好差，成績出咗之後成晚冇瞓。
English_Text: He did badly — after the results came out he didn’t sleep all night.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔想得罪人，所以照佢講嘅做。
English_Text: I didn’t want to offend anyone, so I did as he said.

Cantonese_Text: 個團有二十幾人，好夜先返到酒店。
English_Text: The tour group had twenty-odd people and only got back to the hotel very late.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好行咁快，會撞到裏面啲人。
English_Text: Don’t walk so fast — you’ll bump into the people inside.

Cantonese_Text: 份報紙嘅新聞我永遠都唔信。
English_Text: I never believe the news in that paper.
He asked me and I couldn’t answer — really annoying.

Cantonese_Text: 減咗價之後，好多人先得到機會買。
English_Text: After the price was cut, a lot of people finally got the chance to buy.

Cantonese_Text: 條路遲啲會封，唔好行嗰邊。
English_Text: That road will be closed later — don’t go that way.
surely not / could it be that
