Cantonese_Text: 東廠要千二苗，南廠要九百五。
一共兩千一百五十棵苗仔。
English_Text: Two thousand one hundred and fifty baby plants in total.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠嘅苗要喺下晝一點前搞掂。
English_Text: ESG’s clones have to be finished before one o’clock.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠同南廠嘅苗一定要分開。
English_Text: ESG and NLT cuttings must be kept separate.

Cantonese_Text: 要留夠時間插落苗盤，所以趕住剪。
English_Text: We need time left to stick them in the trays — that’s why we’re rushing the cutting.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠嘅枝可以剪長啲，執葉就同南廠一樣。
English_Text: ESG cuttings can stay longer — clean the leaf the same way as NLT.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠要七百糖果、兩百藍種、三百酒紅。
English_Text: ESG wants 700 Candy Runtz, 200 Blue Andeze, 300 Ron Burgundy.

Cantonese_Text: 泥盆嗰間供應商有冇一加侖嘅布盆？
English_Text: Does the pot supplier have one-gallon fabric pots?
Do they have the one-and-a-half gallon ones in stock?
We haven’t got enough trays — we need to order more.
When does it arrive? We’re waiting on it.
Let me ask, I’ll get back to you.

Cantonese_Text: 今次唔夠人，我叫多兩個阿姨返嚟。
English_Text: We’re short-handed — I’ll get two more aunties in.
With Tsing that’s six of us in total.

Cantonese_Text: 林生，星期一落乾房二號同三號嘅花。有個新做法，記得照住做。
English_Text: Uncle — Monday, bring down the flower from Dry Rooms B and C. There’s a new procedure, make sure you follow it.

Cantonese_Text: 八號房今日第四十三日。禮拜日要摘第二次葉。
English_Text: Room 8 is on day 43 today. The second leaf removal is due Sunday.

Cantonese_Text: 南廠乾房二號，前面同角落嗰啲得喇，中間仲有啲濕。
English_Text: NLT Dry Room B — the front and the corners are ready, but the middle is still a little moist.

Cantonese_Text: 禮拜三朝早八點嚟南廠幫手剪苗，一共兩千一百五十棵。
English_Text: Wednesday 8am, come to NLT to help cut the baby clones — 2,150 in total.

Cantonese_Text: 泥盆供應商有冇一加侖或者一加侖半嘅布盆？
English_Text: Does the soil pot supplier have one-gallon or one-and-a-half gallon fabric pots?

Cantonese_Text: 南廠星期一落乾房二號嘅嘢，跟住開始拆枝。
English_Text: NLT, Monday — bring down what’s in Dry Room B and start the bucking.

Cantonese_Text: 南廠要阿姨幫手摘六號同七號房嘅葉，第四十五日第二次。
English_Text: NLT needs the aunties to de-leaf Rooms 6 and 7 — second removal, day 45.

Cantonese_Text: 南廠星期一一號同九號房收成，成棵斬晒佢。
English_Text: NLT, Monday — Rooms 1 and 9 get harvested. Cut all the plants down.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠嘅枝可以留長啲，執葉就同南廠一樣。
English_Text: For ESG you can keep the clone cuttings long — just clean the leaf the same way as NLT.

Cantonese_Text: 要留夠時間插苗，所以要早啲剪完。
English_Text: There has to be enough time to stick the clones in the trays — that’s why we’re rushing to finish the cuttings early.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠千二苗，南廠九百五。
English_Text: 1,200 clones for ESG and 950 for NLT.

Cantonese_Text: 我叫咗林生帶多兩個阿姨嚟。阿勝都可以幫手，一共六個人。
English_Text: I asked Uncle to bring two more aunties. Tsing can help too, so six people in total.

Cantonese_Text: 東廠要喺一點前攞晒千二苗。你哋三個而家剪緊南廠嘅，所以我再叫兩個阿姨。
English_Text: ESG needs all 1,200 of their cuttings before 1pm. The three of you are on NLT’s first, so I’ll get two more aunties in.

Cantonese_Text: 你想聽日落乾花定係等到禮拜三？
English_Text: Do you want to take the dry flower down tomorrow, or wait until Wednesday?

Cantonese_Text: 記得要分開東廠同南廠嘅苗。
English_Text: Remember we need to separate the ESG and NLT cuttings.
Bring it here, let me have a look.
That’s enough, that’s enough — no need for that many.
No more — don’t get any more.
Don’t do it that way next time.

Cantonese_Text: 哩間房今日摘葉，唔好搞到啲花呀。
English_Text: This room’s getting de-leafed today — mind the flowers.

Cantonese_Text: 剪落嚟擺入桶呀，唔好掟落地。
English_Text: Trimmings go in the bin, don’t chuck them on the floor.

Cantonese_Text: 哩行搞掂未？未搞掂唔好走去第二行。
English_Text: This row done? Don’t wander to the next one till it is.

Cantonese_Text: 慢慢嚟，唔使急。整爛咗就冇得補㗎喇。
English_Text: Take your time, no rush. Break it and that’s that.
Once this room’s done, take a breather.
Just the leaves — leave the flower alone.

Cantonese_Text: 啲葉跌晒喺地下，執下啦。
English_Text: There’s leaf all over the floor — give it a tidy.
This has gone mouldy — bin it.
Any mould? Have a proper look.
Tell me the weight once you’ve weighed it.
Too hot — turn the AC up.
These two are different — look properly.

Cantonese_Text: 哩批同嗰批一樣，一齊擺。
English_Text: This lot and that lot are the same — put them together.
If we all do it together it’s quicker.
Do them separately — don’t mix them up.
Slowly does it — no need to rush.
Hurry up — we’re pressed to get off.
Come on, let’s go — we’re done.
What time are you in tomorrow?

Cantonese_Text: 公公婆婆係阿媽嗰邊嘅。
English_Text: Gung-gung and po-po are on my mum’s side.
Ye-ye and maa-maa are dad’s side.

Cantonese_Text: 呢個係我阿媽個大佬，我叫佢舅父。
English_Text: This is my mum’s older brother — I call him kau-fu.

Cantonese_Text: 大過阿媽嘅叫姨媽，細過就叫阿姨。
English_Text: Older than my mum is ji-maa, younger is aa-ji.

Cantonese_Text: 佢係我表姐，唔係我家姐。
English_Text: She’s my cousin, not my sister.
I got the name wrong — so embarrassing.

Cantonese_Text: 唔識叫就笑下先，跟住問阿媽。
English_Text: If you don’t know what to call them, smile first and ask your mum after.

Cantonese_Text: 唔使咁客氣，坐低飲啖茶。
English_Text: No need to stand on ceremony — sit down, have some tea.
Long time no see — you’ve lost weight.

Cantonese_Text: 食咗飯未呀？煮咗餸等你。
English_Text: Have you eaten? There’s food waiting for you.
I’m off — I’ll come again soon.
Bad signal — let me step outside.

Cantonese_Text: 我而家喺出面，遲啲覆你。
English_Text: I’m out at the moment — I’ll get back to you.

Cantonese_Text: 阿媽問你幾時返嚟食飯。
English_Text: Mum’s asking when you’re coming back for dinner.
Don’t worry about me — I’m fine.
Ring me back when you’ve got a minute.
Let’s do yum cha — I’ll order another basket of har gow.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好淨係食一樣，試下呢個。
English_Text: Don’t just eat the one thing — try this.
I’m full — I genuinely can’t manage any more.
Pass me a bowl and chopsticks, thanks.
This dish has gone cold — warm it up.
I’m paying — don’t you dare fight me on it.
What work are you doing these days?

Cantonese_Text: 有冇拍拖呀？帶返嚟睇下。
English_Text: Are you seeing anyone? Bring them round so we can have a look.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好問咁多啦，佢啱啱返到嚟。
English_Text: Stop with the questions — he’s only just got here.
I don’t even know what to say.
Just laugh it off — no need to take it seriously.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該，去廟街行邊個出口呀？
English_Text: Excuse me — which exit for Temple Street?

Cantonese_Text: 我要去中環，喺邊度轉車？
English_Text: I need Central — where do I change?

Cantonese_Text: 哩班車去唔去尖沙咀㗎？
English_Text: Does this one go to Tsim Sha Tsui?
It’s packed right now — wait for the next one.
I’d like to put a hundred on it.
Where do I buy a ticket?
The machine won’t take my card.

Cantonese_Text: 唔該幫我睇下仲有幾多錢。
English_Text: Could you check what’s left on it?
Does this minibus go to Mong Kok?

Cantonese_Text: 落車先俾錢定係上車俾？
English_Text: Do I pay getting off or getting on?

Cantonese_Text: 今日要插一百枝苗㗎喎，唔少呀。
English_Text: We’ve got a hundred clones to cut today — that’s not nothing.

Cantonese_Text: 喺母株度剪，揀啲靚嘅枝。
English_Text: Cut off the mother — pick the good shoots.

Cantonese_Text: 剪完即刻篤生根粉，唔好擺喺度。
English_Text: Straight into the rooting powder — don’t leave it lying there.
Push it in firm — one nudge and it’s out.
One cutting per pot, that’s all you need.

Cantonese_Text: 剪刀記得消毒呀，唔係會傳病㗎。
English_Text: Sanitise the shears, yeah? Otherwise you spread disease.

Cantonese_Text: 哩批生唔生到根，兩個禮拜就知。
English_Text: We’ll know in two weeks whether this batch takes root.
The junction up ahead is fine.
I’m in a rush — can we go quicker?
Where do I get the Star Ferry?
What time does the next boat leave?
Does the ding-ding go to Causeway Bay?
You pay when you get off.
How long is the boat to Cheung Chau?
Iced lemon tea, less sugar, thanks.

Cantonese_Text: 一個常餐，凍飲加錢係咪？
English_Text: One regular set — cold drink costs extra, right?
Tea and two baskets will do.
Could I have the dim sum sheet?
One har gow and one siu mai.
Have you still got rice rolls?
Can you go light on the oil and salt?
We ordered a long while ago.
Can we take the rest away?
Excuse me — how much is this?
Have you got a bigger size?
When are you getting more in?
Could you wrap it for me?
Could you clean it for me?
I’ll take two — give me a better price.
The next stall is a lot cheaper.
I’ve no small notes — only a hundred.

Cantonese_Text: 哩排啲盆好乾喎，淋下水啦。
English_Text: This row’s bone dry — give them a water.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好淋太多呀，浸親個根就死㗎喇。
English_Text: Don’t overdo it — drown the roots and they’re gone.

Cantonese_Text: 今日落肥呀，唔係淨係清水。
English_Text: We’re feeding today, not just plain water.
Mix the nutrient up properly before you use it.
Tick the sheet when you’re done.

Cantonese_Text: 黃咗葉嗰幾盆，影張相俾我睇下。
English_Text: Those few with yellow leaves — snap me a photo.

Cantonese_Text: 唔知係唔係肥落多咗，我睇下先。
English_Text: Not sure if we overfed them — let me have a look.
Sorry — I don’t know my way.
How do I get to the MTR station?
Could you write the address down for me?

Cantonese_Text: 可唔可以借個電話用下？

English_Text: I want to see a doctor.
I’ve been coughing for a week.
Can I get it without a prescription?
Please call the police for me.
I got off at the wrong stop.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔識講廣東話，你識唔識英文？
English_Text: I don’t speak Cantonese — do you speak English?
This is nothing to do with me.
How many clones does this run need?

Cantonese_Text: 一共要九百，你哋剪咗幾多？
English_Text: Nine hundred all in — how many have you cut?
Seven hundred done, two hundred short.
How many shoots are left on the mothers?

Cantonese_Text: 淨係剩返一百枝咋，唔夠。
English_Text: Only a hundred left — not enough.
Count them properly before they go in the tray.
How many pounds of this strain are done?

Cantonese_Text: 糖果做咗六十磅，藍種仲未開始。
English_Text: Sixty pounds of Candy done — Blue hasn’t been started.
What did we get out today?
Have you tallied it up after weighing?
Only half a pound — that’s too little.
Write it down as each tote gets weighed.
How many more pounds till we’re there?

Cantonese_Text: 哩箱係糖果，嗰箱係藍種，唔好撈亂。
English_Text: This tote is Candy, that one’s Blue — don’t mix them.
Finish this tote before you open the next one.
How many totes are still untrimmed?
Leave that strain alone for now.

Cantonese_Text: 每箱貼咗品種同房號未？
English_Text: Is every tote labelled with the strain and the room?
Whatever’s left we’ll deal with tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 話俾啲阿姨知，剪哩幾箱先。
English_Text: Tell the aunties to trim these totes first.

Cantonese_Text: 同佢哋講，唔好剪嗰個品種住。
English_Text: Tell them not to touch that strain yet.
Remember to give Ling a shout about it.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好淨係話俾一個人知，兩邊都要講。
English_Text: Don’t just tell one person — both sides need to know.
I’ve put it in the group chat.
Did they get it? Let me know.

Cantonese_Text: 我而家喺東廠，你同林生講。
English_Text: I’m at ESG right now — you tell Uncle.

Cantonese_Text: 而家廿八度，濕度六十五。
濕度高過七十就要開抽濕機。
English_Text: Over 70 humidity, put the dehumidifier on.
It climbs three or four degrees when the lights come on.
Check the readings twice a day.
Start at quarter past three — don’t be late.
Another hour and a half will do it.
You only get half an hour for lunch.
Off at quarter to six — don’t slip away early.

Cantonese_Text: 間房太濕喇，開埋部抽濕機啦。
English_Text: Room’s too humid — stick the dehumidifier on too.

Cantonese_Text: 而家幾多度呀？俾我睇下。
English_Text: What’s it reading now? Let me see.

Cantonese_Text: 架風扇唔好對正棵嘢吹呀。
English_Text: Don’t aim the fan right at the plant.
Once the lights are off, stay out of the room.
Shut that door properly — no light leaks.

Cantonese_Text: 部機好似壞咗喎，你聽下有冇聲。
English_Text: That unit sounds dead — have a listen, is it running?

Cantonese_Text: 哩間房好焗呀，開大啲個風。
English_Text: This room’s stuffy — turn the air up a bit.
Only a dollar fifty — that’s cheap.
A hundred won’t even cover it.
This tote is a good two pounds light.
The numbers don’t tally — let’s weigh it again.
Did a tote get missed off?
Hold on — let me look at the sheet first.

Cantonese_Text: 可能寫錯咗，唔一定係唔見咗。
English_Text: It might just be written down wrong — doesn’t mean it’s gone.

Cantonese_Text: 邊個磅嘅？我唔係怪佢，我想問下。
English_Text: Who weighed it? I’m not blaming them — I just want to ask.

Cantonese_Text: 搵返晒先算，唔使急住報。
English_Text: Find it all first — no rush to report it.

Cantonese_Text: 六號房琴日冇淋水，係咪？
English_Text: Room 6 didn’t get watered yesterday — is that right?
The lights didn’t go off last night.

Cantonese_Text: 抽濕機停咗都冇人發覺。
English_Text: The dehumidifier stopped and nobody noticed.
We’ve only just found it — that’s not too late.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係邊個嘅錯，係冇人負責睇。
English_Text: It’s nobody’s fault — nobody was given the job of checking.

Cantonese_Text: 以後每晚要有人行一轉。
English_Text: From now on someone walks it every night.
It can be put right — no need to panic.
Auntie — could you come over a moment?

Cantonese_Text: 係我冇講清楚，唔關你事。
English_Text: I didn’t explain it properly — this isn’t on you.

Cantonese_Text: 哩箱唔係哩個品種，我哋分返出嚟。
English_Text: Wrong strain in this tote — let’s separate it back out.
Never mind — it can be put right.

Cantonese_Text: 下次唔肯定就問我，唔使驚。
English_Text: Next time just ask me if you’re not sure — don’t worry about it.
Don’t say it in front of everyone — it makes her lose face.

Cantonese_Text: 你做得好好，係我講漏咗。
English_Text: You’ve done it well — I’m the one who left it out.
I got it wrong — sorry about that.
I forgot to tell you — I deserve the earful.

Cantonese_Text: 唔係佢哋嘅問題，係我安排錯。
English_Text: It’s not on them — I arranged it wrong.
I’ll go and set it straight now.

Cantonese_Text: 下次我寫低先講，唔靠記。
English_Text: Next time I’ll write it down before I say it — not rely on memory.
Don’t wait until something goes wrong to say it.

Cantonese_Text: 你今個禮拜做咗幾多個鐘？
English_Text: How many hours have you done this week?
Overtime is counted — you won’t be short.
Do you want cash or a transfer?

Cantonese_Text: 我對返數先，唔啱就補返俾你。
English_Text: Let me check the figures — if it’s wrong I’ll make it up to you.

Cantonese_Text: 有咩問題即刻同我講，唔使等出糧。
English_Text: Any problem, tell me straight away — don’t wait for payday.
That’s four extra hours this week.
I’m ill today — I can’t come in.
I’ll be a bit late — traffic.

Cantonese_Text: 我想早走一個鐘，得唔得？
English_Text: Could I leave an hour early?
That’s fine — just make the hours up.

Cantonese_Text: 唔嚟就話聲，唔好唔出聲。
English_Text: If you’re not coming, say so — don’t just go quiet.
Have you done this sort of work before?
Now you have a go — I’ll watch.
Take your time — neat beats fast.

Cantonese_Text: 明唔明呀？唔明就再講一次。
English_Text: Do you follow? If not I’ll say it again.
If you don’t know, ask — don’t guess.

Cantonese_Text: 第一日唔使做咁快，睇清楚先。
English_Text: No need to be quick on your first day — look properly first.

Cantonese_Text: 部抽濕機壞咗，唔轉㗎喇。
English_Text: The dehumidifier’s packed in — it isn’t turning.

Cantonese_Text: 你聽下有冇聲，定係完全冇反應？
English_Text: Have a listen — any noise at all, or nothing?

Cantonese_Text: 整唔整得返？定係要換過部新？
English_Text: Can it be fixed, or does it need replacing?
I’ll get someone in to look at it tomorrow.

Cantonese_Text: 未整好之前，用返舊嗰部先。
English_Text: Use the old one until it’s fixed.

Cantonese_Text: 要換零件，可能要等一個禮拜。
English_Text: It needs a part — that could be a week.

Cantonese_Text: 壞咗即刻話我知，唔好等我發現。
English_Text: Tell me the moment something breaks — don’t wait for me to find it.
Delivery’s here — check it in first.

Cantonese_Text: 對返張單，睇下夠唔夠數。
English_Text: Check it against the docket — is the count right?
Five bags short — I’ll ring them.

Cantonese_Text: 送錯咗，哩啲唔係我哋叫嘅。
English_Text: Wrong delivery — this isn’t what we ordered.
Count it properly before you sign for it.

Cantonese_Text: 張單擺喺辦公室，唔好掟咗佢。
English_Text: Docket goes in the office — don’t chuck it.
Carry it into the store — don’t leave it in the doorway.

Cantonese_Text: 哩棵有蟲呀，快啲搬走佢。
English_Text: This one’s got bugs — get it out of here.

Cantonese_Text: 葉底有紅蜘蛛喎，睇下第二棵有冇。
English_Text: Mites under the leaves — check if the others have them.

Cantonese_Text: 發咗霉就唔好留喇，唔要得㗎。
English_Text: If it’s mouldy, bin it — we can’t use it.
Mask on before you spray, yeah?

Cantonese_Text: 見到唔妥即刻話我知，唔好等。
English_Text: Anything looks off, tell me right away — don’t sit on it.

Cantonese_Text: 摸完病嗰棵，洗咗手先好掂第二棵呀。
English_Text: After the sick one, wash your hands before you touch another.

Cantonese_Text: 弊喇，成行都有，唔止一棵。
English_Text: Damn — the whole row’s got it, not just the one.

Cantonese_Text: 上車之前點清楚幾多箱。
English_Text: Count the totes before it goes on the van.
Ring me when you get there.
The paperwork travels with the load.

Cantonese_Text: 落貨嗰陣叫佢哋簽返個名。
English_Text: Get them to sign for it when it’s unloaded.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好一次過搬晒，分兩轉。
English_Text: Don’t take it all at once — do it in two runs.

Cantonese_Text: 收工前行一轉，睇下有冇嘢冇熄。
English_Text: Walk round before you knock off — check nothing’s been left on.
Shut every door properly before you leave.

Cantonese_Text: 有嘢唔妥就打俾我，唔好自己搞。
English_Text: Anything not right, ring me — don’t sort it yourself.

Cantonese_Text: 記得閂冷氣，唔係開足一晚。
English_Text: Remember the AC, or it runs all night.
Wednesday is harvest — eight o’clock start.
Thursday we cut clones — six people needed.

Cantonese_Text: 禮拜五剪乾花，乾房二號嗰批。
English_Text: Friday, trim dry flower — the lot in Dry Room B.

Cantonese_Text: 邊日做邊樣，我寫低咗喺群組。
English_Text: What happens on which day is in the group chat.
Check we’ve got the hands for it first.
Once it’s fixed, we don’t move it.

Cantonese_Text: 收成推遲兩日，禮拜五先做。
English_Text: Harvest slips two days — Friday instead.
Could we bring it forward a day?
The dates clash — both sites want people.
Which is more urgent? That one goes first.

Cantonese_Text: 摘葉可以遲，收成唔可以。
改咗期記得話俾大家知。
English_Text: If the date moves, tell everyone.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好臨時先講，佢哋要安排。
English_Text: Don’t leave it to the last minute — they’ve got to arrange things.
Is that lot in the dry room ready?
Get the pen and check the moisture.
Eleven percent is where we want it.
Bend a stem — if it snaps, it’s dry.

Cantonese_Text: 過乾就散晒，唔好等太耐。
English_Text: Overdry and it falls apart — don’t leave it too long.
The ones in the middle need checking again.
This lot isn’t dry enough — leave it for now.

Cantonese_Text: 要剪乾房三號嗰批，唔係二號。
English_Text: It’s Dry Room C we want, not B.
Hands off a second — let me look at the tag.

Cantonese_Text: 每架都貼咗房號同日期。
English_Text: Every rack is labelled with the room and the date.

Cantonese_Text: 剪咗嗰啲分開擺，唔好撈埋。
English_Text: Keep what’s been cut separate — don’t mix it in.
Ask me which lot before you bring anything down.
How many pounds have been checked over?
How many one-pound bags are filled?

Cantonese_Text: 八號房總共出咗幾多磅？
English_Text: What did Room 8 give us in total?

Cantonese_Text: 揀完先入袋，唔好連碎一齊入。
English_Text: Sort it before bagging — don’t put the shake in with it.

Cantonese_Text: 每袋要啱一磅，唔好多唔好少。
English_Text: Every bag exactly a pound — not over, not under.

Cantonese_Text: 封好貼返標籤，寫房號同品種。
English_Text: Seal it, label it, room number and strain.
Write each weight down — we tally up tonight.
This one’s got mould — don’t trim it in.
Pick it out — don’t let it near the good stuff.

Cantonese_Text: 一枝有就成架都要睇過。
English_Text: One branch with it means the whole rack gets looked at.

Cantonese_Text: 剪走一啲都唔得，成枝掟咗佢。
English_Text: Cutting a bit out isn’t good enough — bin the whole branch.

Cantonese_Text: 剪刀用完消毒，唔好傳去第枝。
English_Text: Sanitise the shears after — don’t carry it to the next one.

Cantonese_Text: 有霉嗰批唔好入袋，另外擺。
English_Text: That lot doesn’t get bagged — keep it apart.
Pull the A grade out as you trim — same motion.

Cantonese_Text: 淨係揀大花，細花同碎花擺埋一齊。
English_Text: Only the A comes out — B and C go in the same bin.

Cantonese_Text: 細花碎花之後喺篩盤先分。
English_Text: B and C get split later on the sifting tray.

Cantonese_Text: 大花揀咗出嚟，篩五次就得，唔使十次。
English_Text: With the A out first it’s five passes on the tray, not ten.

Cantonese_Text: 篩少幾次，啲花冇咁易磨爛。
English_Text: Fewer passes means less of the flower gets knocked about.

Cantonese_Text: 唔知邊級就問，唔好亂入。
English_Text: If you’re not sure which grade, ask — don’t just bag it.
Weigh each grade separately — don’t add them together.
Lids off all the totes first thing.

Cantonese_Text: 由左至右倒一倒，等啲花翻身。
English_Text: Tip them left to right so the flower turns over.
Leave the lids off fifteen to twenty minutes.
Time’s up — snap the lids back on.

Cantonese_Text: 夜晚每箱搖十到十五秒。
English_Text: End of day, shake each bin ten to fifteen seconds.
Lid straight back on after the shake.

Cantonese_Text: 養護房要熄晒燈，唔好開。
English_Text: Cure room stays dark — lights off, leave them off.

Cantonese_Text: 今日收成，八點開工，大家早啲返呀。
English_Text: Harvest today, eight o’clock start — get in a bit early.

Cantonese_Text: 成棵斬落嚟就得，唔使一枝枝剪。
English_Text: Just take the whole plant down, no need to go branch by branch.

Cantonese_Text: 掛上去唔好逼咁埋，唞唔到氣㗎。
English_Text: Don’t pack them tight on the line — they need air.

Cantonese_Text: 每架寫低邊間房嚟㗎，唔好靠記。
English_Text: Write which room each rack came from — don’t rely on memory.

Cantonese_Text: 哩間搞掂未？搞掂就過第二間。
English_Text: This one done? If so, move to the next room.

Cantonese_Text: 今日做到幾點呀？六點左右收工啦。
English_Text: How late are we today? Knock off around six.

Cantonese_Text: 今日好攰呀，做完請你哋飲嘢。
English_Text: Long day — drinks on me when we’re done.

Cantonese_Text: 養護要幾耐睇含水量，唔係數日子。
English_Text: How long the cure runs is set by moisture, not by counting days.

Cantonese_Text: 濕啲嘅要耐啲，乾啲嘅一兩日就得。
English_Text: Wetter material takes longer; drier is ready in a day or two.

Cantonese_Text: 廿七加侖箱，養緊擺六到七磅。
English_Text: Six to seven pounds in a 27 gallon tote during the cure.

Cantonese_Text: 五十四加侖箱擺十二到十四磅。
English_Text: Twelve to fourteen pounds in a 54 gallon.

Cantonese_Text: 大箱好啲，表面大啲，透氣勻啲。
English_Text: The big tote is better — more surface, more even air exchange.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好壓實底下，唔係會焗住。
English_Text: Don’t pack the bottom tight or it holds the moisture in.

Cantonese_Text: 養完先磅，廿七加侖箱九到十磅。
English_Text: Weigh after the cure — nine to ten pounds per 27 gallon tote.

Cantonese_Text: 啲葉係機器剪，唔使你哋剪。
English_Text: The machine takes the leaf — that isn’t your job.
You take off the branch and stem that’s left.
Hand trim only starts after the machine’s done.

Cantonese_Text: 幾時可以機剪，睇含水量話事。
English_Text: When the machine runs is decided by the moisture, nothing else.

Cantonese_Text: 機器修剪間六十度，濕度五十五。
人工修剪間六十到六十二度。
兩間房嘅數都要對得住張紙。
English_Text: Both rooms have to match what the sheet says.

Cantonese_Text: 剪完即刻搬入儲存間，唔好擺喺度。
English_Text: Straight to the storage room when it’s done — don’t leave it standing.

Cantonese_Text: 剪完嘅花最易整壞，要即刻分磅入袋。
English_Text: Finished flower is at its most vulnerable — pound it out and bag it now.

Cantonese_Text: 火雞袋摺埋袋口，唔好扎。
English_Text: Fold the turkey bag over — don’t tie it.

Cantonese_Text: 擋光係靠個箱蓋，唔係靠個袋。
English_Text: The lid is what seals out the light, not the bag.

Cantonese_Text: 唔夠時間分磅，就摺內襯：先長邊，後短邊。
English_Text: No time to pound it out — fold the liner, long sides first, then the short.
Fold it, lid on, into storage.

Cantonese_Text: 儲存間五十五度，濕度五十，全黑。
English_Text: Storage at 55°F, 50% RH, in the dark.

Cantonese_Text: 禮拜一收成，下個禮拜一落。
English_Text: Harvest Monday, take it down the following Monday.

Cantonese_Text: 第八日係目標，唔係死線。
English_Text: Day 8 is the target, not the deadline.

Cantonese_Text: 未夠乾就唔好落，寧願多掛幾日。
English_Text: Don’t bring it down wet — better to hang it a few more days.

Cantonese_Text: 第十二日唔係一定要落，係一定要決定。
English_Text: Day 12 doesn’t force it down — it forces a decision.

Cantonese_Text: 重貨第一日就要講，唔好等到落嗰日。
English_Text: A heavy load gets flagged on Day 1, not on takedown day.

Cantonese_Text: 拖長咗要即刻話俾剪房知。
English_Text: If it runs long, tell the trim room straight away.

Cantonese_Text: 三樣都要做齊：屈枝、度水份、磅重。
English_Text: All three checks get done: snap, meter, weight.

Cantonese_Text: 六成以上細枝一屈就斷。
English_Text: Sixty percent or more of the small branches snap cleanly.

Cantonese_Text: 主枝仲彎唔緊要，唔好等佢。
English_Text: Main stalks still bending is normal — don’t wait on them.

Cantonese_Text: 花蕾要百分之十一到十二先啱。
English_Text: Buds have to read eleven to twelve percent.

Cantonese_Text: 重量要跌咗七成半到八成。
English_Text: Weight has to be down seventy-five to eighty percent.

Cantonese_Text: 濕嗰邊信磅重，乾嗰邊信支筆。
English_Text: On the wet side trust the weight; on the dry side trust the meter.

Cantonese_Text: 四個位都要度，唔好淨係度一個架。
English_Text: Sample four positions — not just the rack nearest the door.

Cantonese_Text: 哩間房淨係用一支水份筆，唔好換。
English_Text: This room runs one moisture meter — don’t swap it.

Cantonese_Text: 冇一支筆係為花校過，讀嘅係木嘅刻度。
English_Text: No meter is calibrated for flower — they all read a wood scale.

Cantonese_Text: 換咗第二支，個標準就唔同咗。
English_Text: A different meter moves the number without telling you.

Cantonese_Text: 針要直要乾淨，彎咗就換針。
English_Text: Pins straight and clean — bent ones get replaced.
Wipe the pins with alcohol after every sample.

Cantonese_Text: 掛嗰日綁三枝：一高、一低、一個死角。
English_Text: Tag three branches on hang day: one high, one low, one in dead air.

Cantonese_Text: 磅返嗰三枝，就知跌咗幾多。
English_Text: Reweigh those three and you know how much it’s lost.

Cantonese_Text: 頭三日六十三度，濕度二十。
第四到第七日六十五度，濕度四十五。
落嗰日七十度，濕度五十五。
拖長咗就返返第二階段，唔係第三。
English_Text: An extension goes back to Phase 2, not Phase 3.

Cantonese_Text: 實際同設定差兩度或者五個濕度就要改。
English_Text: Drift over 2°F or 5% RH gets corrected and noted.

Cantonese_Text: 實際濕度成日高過設定，即係機唔夠力，較細個掣冇用。
English_Text: Actual RH always above setpoint means capacity, not setpoint — turning the dial down does nothing.
No fan points at the hanging flower.

Cantonese_Text: 濕重要入一半，唔係全數。
English_Text: Enter half the wet weight, not the full number.

Cantonese_Text: 提交咗就改唔到，刪唔到。
English_Text: Once it’s submitted you can’t change it or delete it.

Cantonese_Text: 入錯咗唔緊要，再入多次啱嘅。
English_Text: A wrong entry isn’t a problem — just submit the right one again.

Cantonese_Text: 未搞掂之前，唔好入系統住。
English_Text: Don’t put it in the system until we’ve sorted it.

Cantonese_Text: 先寫落張表度，遲啲先入。
English_Text: Put it on the sheet for now, enter it later.
If it goes red, something’s wrong with the entry.

Cantonese_Text: 唔識就等我嚟教你，唔好亂試。
English_Text: If you’re not sure, wait for me — don’t guess at it.

Cantonese_Text: 佢要等埋張單先可以走。
English_Text: He has to wait for the paperwork before he can leave.
Print two copies of the manifest and two of the invoice.
The driver pays six hundred and eighty.

Cantonese_Text: 收咗錢擺喺辦公室，等我嚟攞。
English_Text: Put the money in the office — I’ll come and get it.

Cantonese_Text: 未有文件就叫佢等，唔好急。
English_Text: No paperwork yet — tell him to wait, don’t rush it.
Coming in, you use the fingerprint and the card.
For lunch it’s the fingerprint only.
Going home, you punch out with the card.

Cantonese_Text: 指紋唔好超過一個禮拜廿四個鐘。
English_Text: Don’t go over twenty-four hours a week on the fingerprint.

Cantonese_Text: 有人喺你隔籬就唔好打，等佢走先。
English_Text: Don’t clock in with people standing next to you — wait until they’ve gone.
Send me a photo of the card at the end of the month.

Cantonese_Text: 剪靚啲呀，慢少少冇所謂。
English_Text: Trim it nice — a bit slower is fine.

Cantonese_Text: 剪好嘅擺左邊，未剪擺右邊，唔好撈亂。
English_Text: Trimmed on the left, untrimmed on the right — don’t mix them.

Cantonese_Text: 磅完寫低個數，唔好靠估呀。
English_Text: Write the number down after weighing — no guessing.

Cantonese_Text: 每袋貼返個標籤，日期寫清楚。
English_Text: Label every bag, and write the date clearly.

Cantonese_Text: 唔同房嘅嘢唔好撈亂呀，好煩㗎。
English_Text: Don’t mix rooms up — it’s a nightmare to sort out.

Cantonese_Text: 哩袋未夠乾，遲啲先入袋。
English_Text: This lot isn’t dry yet — bag it later.

Cantonese_Text: 差唔多喇，仲爭少少就得。
English_Text: Nearly there — just a bit more to go.

Cantonese_Text: 哩邊嘅花全部由機器做。
English_Text: Everything from this site goes through the machine.

Cantonese_Text: 阿姨淨係負責拆枝，唔好手剪。
English_Text: The aunties take the branches off — they don’t hand trim it.

Cantonese_Text: 機器做完，剩返啲細枝先俾阿姨執。
English_Text: After the machine, the aunties clean up the small stems that are left.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好喺機器做之前俾阿姨剪。
English_Text: Don’t give it to the aunties before the machine has had it.

Cantonese_Text: 每個品種留五磅俾阿姨手剪做對比。
English_Text: Five pounds of each strain gets hand trimmed for comparison.

Cantonese_Text: 留嘅要同樣質素，唔好揀最靚嗰啲。
English_Text: Set aside the same quality — don’t pick the best of it.

Cantonese_Text: 兩間廠嘅花唔可以撈埋。
English_Text: The two sites’ flower never gets mixed.
Who told him to do it that way?
He decided it himself without asking anyone.

Cantonese_Text: 佢負責排人，唔係負責排工序。
English_Text: He rosters the people — he doesn’t set the order of the work.

Cantonese_Text: 我會同佢講清楚，唔使你出面。
English_Text: I’ll make it clear to him — you don’t have to.
Don’t take it to heart — it isn’t on you.

Cantonese_Text: 佢冇話俾我知，我都唔知。
English_Text: He didn’t tell me either — I didn’t know.

Cantonese_Text: 下次佢改咗嘢，即刻話我知。
English_Text: Next time he changes something, tell me straight away.
That makes sense — we’ll change it.

Cantonese_Text: 你剪一棵樣板出嚟，我叫佢哋照做。
English_Text: Trim one as a sample and I’ll have them work to it.

Cantonese_Text: 有咩唔妥就講，唔使客氣。
English_Text: Anything that isn’t right, just say — don’t hold back.
I’ll speak to the boss and get a meeting.

Cantonese_Text: 多謝你話我知，我唔喺度就唔知。
English_Text: Thanks for telling me — I’m not here, so I don’t see it.
Power’s out again — it’s like this all day.

Cantonese_Text: 佢哋整緊，大概二十分鐘。
English_Text: They’re working on it — about twenty minutes.
No internet — let me have a look.

Cantonese_Text: 個感應器壞咗，讀數唔啱。
English_Text: The sensor’s gone — the reading is wrong.

Cantonese_Text: 部空調又停咗，我重新開過。
English_Text: The AC cut out again — I’ve restarted it.

Cantonese_Text: 哩啲機成日自己熄，我哋一直留意緊。
English_Text: These units keep switching themselves off — we’ve been watching it.
When the power goes, open the big door for airflow.

Cantonese_Text: 二號房同三號房要摘葉，第二次，清晒啲葉。
English_Text: Rooms 2 and 3 need de-leafing — second pass, all the leaf off.

Cantonese_Text: 第一次淨係清大葉同底部嘅葉。
English_Text: First pass is just the big leaf and the bottom.

Cantonese_Text: 今日係開花第二十一日。
English_Text: Today is day twenty-one of flower.

Cantonese_Text: 二號房係朝早房，六號房係下晝房。
English_Text: Room 2 is a morning room, Room 6 is an afternoon room.

Cantonese_Text: 一間房最多八個阿姨，多過就冇位企。
English_Text: Eight aunties to a room at most — any more and there’s nowhere to stand.

Cantonese_Text: 先清上面，跟住先清下面。
English_Text: Do the top first, then the bottom.
What day can you schedule it?

Cantonese_Text: 下次早兩日話我知，我好安排人。
English_Text: Tell me two days ahead next time so I can roster people.

Cantonese_Text: 你俾個日期我，我先排到人手。
English_Text: Give me a date and then I can get the hands.
Friday, Saturday and Sunday we’re flat out.

Cantonese_Text: 星期四同星期一得唔得？

English_Text: I know you’re rostering four sites.

Cantonese_Text: 唔夠人就話我知，我搵第二啲人。
English_Text: If you’re short, tell me and I’ll find people elsewhere.
Once the date is set I won’t move it.

Cantonese_Text: 要兩千個兩加侖盆，幾時到？
English_Text: Two thousand two-gallon pots — when do they land?

Cantonese_Text: 手套大碼三箱、中碼兩箱、細碼兩箱。
English_Text: Gloves — three boxes large, two medium, two small.
We’re out of rooting powder — needs ordering.
You buy it and I’ll pay you back.

Cantonese_Text: 下次要咩話我知，我去買。
English_Text: Tell me what you need next time and I’ll get it.

Cantonese_Text: 朋友，有時間過嚟一陣得唔得？
English_Text: Mate — have you got a minute to come over?

Cantonese_Text: 唔該晒你，成日都要麻煩你。
English_Text: Thanks a lot — I’m always putting on you.
If you say it works, we’ll do it your way.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔係話你唔啱，我係想問清楚。
English_Text: I’m not saying you’re wrong — I just want to be clear.

Cantonese_Text: 有咩做唔到，你直接同我講。
English_Text: Anything you can’t do, tell me straight.
We should get a meal sometime.
You roster the people, she sets the order of the work.

Cantonese_Text: 邊個做，你話事；幾時做同點做，佢話事。
English_Text: Who does it is your call; when and how is hers.

Cantonese_Text: 兩樣都要，唔係一個人做晒。
English_Text: We need both — it isn’t one person’s job.

Cantonese_Text: 我唔係話邊個啱邊個唔啱。
English_Text: I’m not saying who’s right and who’s wrong.

Cantonese_Text: 之前冇講清楚，係我嘅問題。
English_Text: It was never made clear before — that’s on me.

Cantonese_Text: 以後有咩改動，兩邊都要知。
English_Text: Anything that changes from now on, both sides hear it.

Cantonese_Text: 老闆直接叫你做，都要話我知。
English_Text: If the boss tells you directly, I still need to know.
The three of us sit down and get it straight.
What she just said — do you follow it?
We’re not here to find out who’s at fault.
If we all agree, that’s the decision.
I’ll write it down and send it to everyone.

Cantonese_Text: 入房戴返手套同口罩呀。
English_Text: Gloves and mask before you go in, yeah?

Cantonese_Text: 唔好著住出面對鞋入嚟呀。
English_Text: Don’t come in with your outdoor shoes on.

Cantonese_Text: 手套爛咗就換過對，唔好慳。
English_Text: Gloves torn? Change them — don’t try to save a pair.

Cantonese_Text: 房入面唔好食嘢飲嘢呀。
English_Text: No eating or drinking in the room.

Cantonese_Text: 爬梯嗰陣叫人扶住你呀。
English_Text: Get someone to hold the ladder when you’re up it.

Cantonese_Text: 受咗傷即刻講呀，唔好死頂。
English_Text: If you get hurt, say so — don’t just tough it out.

Cantonese_Text: 唔好意思，哩度唔准影相㗎。
English_Text: Sorry — no photos allowed in here.
Hold on — I’ve got my hands full right now.
I’ll go down and get it later today.

Cantonese_Text: 遲下唔得閒，不如而家做。
English_Text: I’ll be tied up later on — might as well do it now.
I’ll get back to you shortly.
I’ll buy it once we’ve been paid.

Cantonese_Text: 我廣東話唔係好得，唔好意思。

English_Text: I understand it, I just can’t speak it well
I have to go — we’ll talk tomorrow
My mum is from Hong Kong
Sorry — I used the wrong word for you
How do you say this word?
That’s not right — do it again
